body:
Minnesota's Voting Rights Act is a model for states nationwide and exactly the type of pro-voter legislation we need to protect our right to vote.
Team: Fuel our efforts to support bills like this around the country with $25 or more right now >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082224_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=082224_3&amount=25]
MPR: ‘Minnesota Voting Rights Act’ nears governor’s signature after state Senate approval [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082224_3&amount=25]
Team: Amidst all the continuous fights over our right to vote lately we cannot lose sight of our successes -- Minnesota passed a new state Voting Rights Act that will expand voting rights. This bill:
➜ Guarantees voters the right to sue if they face vote suppression or vote dilution.
➜ Guarantees in state law protections previously afforded under the 1965 federal Voting Rights Act.
➜ Uses a person’s address prior to incarceration for setting voting maps, rather than counting their residence in the region where they are incarcerated.
➜ Sharpens a state law that makes it a crime to make and share distorted images and videos intended to influence an election.
Remember: The recent 8th Federal Circuit Court ruling is one of the most dangerous anti-voter rulings we’ve seen in years . In the eight states impacted by the ruling, voters and voting rights organizations can no longer sue to overturn unjust laws under the Voting Rights Act.
This bill in Minnesota restores those protections and codifies them in state law, regardless of how the Supreme Court eventually rules.
Team: We need to expand this progress from Minnesota to other states around the country. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to defend the right to vote and support our work to pass critical pro-voter legislation nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082224_3&amount=25]
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:
GIVE $15 NOW ➜ [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?express_lane=true&refcode=082224_3&amount=15]

Other Amount [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082224_3&amount=35]
The original Voting Rights Act is one of the most important laws ever passed in American history and a critical protection against discrimination in our democracy. With the courts dismantling it piece by piece, we need states to act and protect our right to vote.
We're not the only ones who see it this way. Michael Pernick, voting rights attorney of the NAACP Legal Defense and Educational Fund, said this: “ As Black voters face the greatest assault on voting rights since Jim Crow, Minnesota is embracing the opportunity to build on its progress in advancing the freedom to vote and join the growing list of states protecting voters against unequal access to the ballot. ”
Governors and state legislatures can act to help solve the voting rights crisis . It's up to us to make sure they do their jobs.
Team, we need to spread laws like this around the country like wildfire, from Arizona to Nevada to Georgia. Pitch in $25 or whatever you can today to help expand ballot access and make every vote count nationwide! >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-democracy?refcode=082224_3&amount=25]

subject: I just got off the stage at the DNC
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1812%2E135344%2E_dumY6)

Hey there, I just got off the stage at the Democratic National Convention. In just a short while, Kamala Harris will take the stage to formally accept the nomination as our Democratic nominee.
This is a historic moment for our party, and our country, and I will explain the significance of it for our race. But first, I would love it if you would consider chipping in to my campaign to help us keep Michigan blue in November: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ebs-em-aug24](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240822-3-900&t=2&akid=1812%2E135344%2E_dumY6)**
Friend, the energy at the Democratic Convention this week has been palpable. Everyone I talk to is excited and energized about electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, a midwesterner, this November.
But we cannot get complacent. As I said in my remarks tonight, we have a stark choice in this election. Between an America in retreat from the world, or an America leading the world.
The choice, to me, is clear: I want a President who is rooting for America, instead of tearing her down.
But we know this election will come down to the wire, and the paths to holding the White House, maintaining control of the Senate, and securing the future America deserves all run right through Michigan.
And because our race is top of the ticket after the presidential, it will likely impact the presidential and vice versa.
We’re in a unique situation, with a lot of work to do before Election Day to ensure we keep Michigan blue.
[**So that’s why I ask: will you chip in to my campaign to help us build on-the-ground momentum and keep Michigan blue?**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-aug24._YMjeK&refcode=em240822-3-900&t=3&akid=1812%2E135344%2E_dumY6)

During my speech tonight, I had the honor of sharing a little bit about my family.
My mother was a teenager when I was born and she struggled with addiction. I never met my father.
But I had two incredible grandparents who stepped in and raised me. Everything I know, I learned from them.
In every way a child needs, my grandparents were there for me. As they grew older, it was my privilege to be there for them.
So, when I work to protect Medicare and Social Security, I do it with the personal knowledge of what those big programs meant in small but deeply meaningful ways to my grandparents.
I know what they mean for your parents and grandparents.
_But let’s be clear: That is all at risk today._
Right-wing extremists like Donald Trump and my opponent, Eric Hovde, want to bring us back. If they had it their way, they’d cut Social Security and Medicare. Overturn the Affordable Care Act. Further restrict our reproductive rights. Give tax breaks to billionaires and big corporations while our working families foot the bill.
We can’t let that happen, and as long as we stand together, I know we won’t.
This November, we have the opportunity to move our country forward — to protect and expand affordable health care, restore reproductive rights, cut costs for working families, and protect Social Security and Medicare for our parents and grandparents. But it will take ALL of us.

name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: What I shared in my Convention speech
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Shoot, I wouldn’t trust those guys to move my couch.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2319%2E4032634%2E1P1LhW)
---
I can take a moment to catch my breath now that I just finished my speech at the Democratic National Convention. It was an honor to be at the United Center in Chicago, feeling the palpable energy in the room shared by Democrats from all across the country, and having the chance to speak about Kamala Harris. Here's what I said about why I'm in this fight for Kamala Harris: What I love most about Kamala is that she can’t be bought — and she can’t be bossed around. I know this firsthand — I first met Kamala in the aftermath of the 2008 financial crash. The banks had flat out broken laws, cheated people, and stolen homes. Millions of Americans had lost their jobs, their savings, their homes. I was setting up the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau. (Yay, CFPB!) Kamala was protecting families as California’s Attorney General. Donald was scamming students at Trump University and trying to make money off people losing their homes. Kamala Harris stepped up. She enforced the law, fought the giant banks, and delivered BILLIONS of dollars of help for families. And THAT’S the difference between a criminal and a prosecutor. You know what else I love about Kamala? She gets it. We need to make life more affordable for working people. Donald Trump, the felon, has no plan to lower costs for families. He doesn’t know how — and frankly, he doesn’t really care. When did he ever fill up a gas tank or worry about a grocery bill? The only bills he worries about are from his criminal defense lawyers. But Kamala? She cares deep down, and she will take on the giant corporations that are squeezing American families. In fact, it’s something she’s done before. During the California wildfires, she went after the price gougers. During the pandemic, we worked together in the Senate to stop price gouging. And as President, she’ll lower costs for your family. She’ll take on the Wall Street firms that buy up millions of houses and apartments then jack up the rent. She’ll take on drug companies that charge an arm and a leg for prescriptions. She’ll take on corporate monopolies that rip off consumers—and billionaires who DON’T PAY TAXES. And she’ll take on right-wing extremists who think THEY should decide who has access to abortion or IVF. Kamala will protect abortion rights nationwide. Groceries. Gas. Housing. Healthcare. Taxes. Abortion. Trust Donald Trump and JD Vance to look out for your family? Shoot, I wouldn’t trust those guys to move my couch. We NEED Kamala Harris. This election is about your family and your future. I’ve seen Kamala Harris fight. I’ve seen her win. When it comes to our families and our futures, Kamala Harris is someone we can trust. With joy in our hearts, let’s elect Kamala Harris as the next President of the United States. [**Will you split a donation between the Harris-Walz ticket and my re-election campaign right now? Help make sure we hold the White House, hold the Senate, and can make real change for working families.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2578?amount=28&t=8&akid=2319%2E4032634%2E1P1LhW)

name: Maxwell's iPhone
subject: just got off the stage
body:
Hey Peter, it’s Maxwell. I wanted to reach out with a quick update before my critical end of month deadline at midnight.

So, by buying, you’re actually making a difference.

Thank you for your support. Really.

Friend, I just got off the stage after speaking at the Democratic National Convention, and I have to tell you: **The energy that Democrats have right now – the energy that was in this completely packed building tonight – is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before.**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91344619/493566163/1682731468?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&refcode=jtk4509-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDYwMTJjYi1lZDYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=edChU7NxrLJtsIiiFwy7h_O7c5OpTdGFNN1Mpa3eU9g=)
Everywhere I look, I'm seeing people who are hopeful and excited about this election – and it's not just what I felt tonight. I've been feeling it in Dallas and San Antonio and all across Texas, too. That's how I know we're going to win this race.
**I've been saying since day one of this campaign that we're going to defeat Ted Cruz and protect our Senate majority. Now, I need people like you behind me to get us across the finish line.**
**[If you’re ready to kick Ted Cruz out of the Senate and protect our Democratic Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $5 or more between my campaign and Jacky Rosen’s to help us continue building on this momentum and win in November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91344620/493566164/1682731468?amounts=250,100,50,25,5&amount=5&refcode=jtk4509-bu-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODI5OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZDYwMTJjYi1lZDYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=edChU7NxrLJtsIiiFwy7h_O7c5OpTdGFNN1Mpa3eU9g=)**

I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.
But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare benefits they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.
**All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.**

| | Peter, I just got off the stage after speaking at the Democratic National Convention, and I have to tell you: the energy that Democrats have right now — the energy that was in this completely packed building tonight — is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91345082/493570029/1750909407?amount=25&source=SBD_MV_EM_FR_082224_1_1_AllredSplit&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDUzMSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMTVkNzQ4Zi1mMzYwLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Z29mP9dOzuZRdCZcCr1jHiIws4eT_kCNEKY_7XWUGXw=) Everywhere I look, I'm seeing people who are hopeful and excited about this election — and it's not just what I felt tonight. body:
The energy in Chicago tonight is tangible
#

Friends -
**I just got off the stage at the Democratic National Convention in Chicago, where I had the opportunity to share my story with millions of Americans.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240822-3-BL&t=1&akid=8769%2E3935704%2EEjvzaR)
I was born in the great state of Arizona. I grew up racing motorcycles, mucking stalls, and exploring the beautiful desert.
For five years, I served in Congress from a swing district. Everybody called me a rising star. Then, on January 8th, 2011, a man tried to assassinate me. He shot 19 people. He killed six.
It was a terrible, terrible day.
I almost died, but I fought for my life, and I survived. I learned to walk again, one step at a time. I learned to talk again, one word at a time.
I bring this same grit and determination to our work here at GIFFORDS PAC—work that has saved countless lives from gun violence over the past eleven years.
The energy in Chicago tonight is tangible. There is a renewed hope for our democracy, and I’m sure you can feel it too. My friend Kamala Harris will be a great president. She is ready to serve, and she will be a steadfast partner in our movement for gun safety.
If we all work together, we **_can**_ and **_will**_ elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House this November. I will be doing everything I can to campaign for Vice President Harris and Governor Walz until Election Day. But I can’t do this work without your support.
[**So please. If you’re ready to fuel our work at GIFFORDS PAC to make sure Kamala Harris is the next president of the United States, will you please chip in $3 or any amount you can afford to GIFFORDS PAC?**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240822-3-BL&t=2&akid=8769%2E3935704%2EEjvzaR)

I was born in the great state of Arizona. I grew up racing motorcycles, mucking stalls, and exploring the beautiful desert. For five years, I served in Congress from a swing district. Everybody called me a rising star. Then, on January 8th, 2011, a man tried to assassinate me. He shot 19 people. He killed six. It was a terrible, terrible day. I almost died, but I fought for my life, and I survived. I learned to walk again, one step at a time. I learned to talk again, one word at a time. I bring this same grit and determination to our work here at GIFFORDS PAC—work that has saved countless lives from gun violence over the past eleven years. The energy in Chicago tonight is tangible. There is a renewed hope for our democracy, and I’m sure you can feel it too. My friend Kamala Harris will be a great president. She is ready to serve, and she will be a steadfast partner in our movement for gun safety. If we all work together, we can and will elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House this November. **Peter , I just got off the stage after speaking at the Democratic National Convention, and I have to tell you: **the energy that Democrats have right now – the energy that was in this completely packed building tonight – is unlike anything I’ve ever felt before.

clean_body: The time is now. | = Peter, I had to reach out one more time as the Democratic National Convention comes to a close. All week, we've heard inspiring leaders speak about the work we need to do to elect Kamala Harris as our next president in November, and after every speech, I keep thinking the same thing: EMILYs List was built for this fight. This organization was founded on the idea that electing women up and down the ballot makes America better for all of us. Nearly 40 years later, that idea, now backed by decades of proof, still guides us. It has been such a thrill to see EMILYs List women of the past and present (and who knows, maybe even future!) leading the way at the DNC this week. The energy, excitement, and fierce determination of Democratic women at this moment is undeniable. That's why I'm reaching out — because our Democratic Victory Fund, made possible by a generous group of grassroots donors who agreed to MATCH all contributions to EMILYs List this week, ends at midnight tonight. I just listened to Vice President Kamala Harris give an electrifying speech at the Democratic National Convention—**and I am fired up!**

As our Madame VP spoke, I was reminded of why we fight. Her words were powerful and her message was clear: **we will NOT go back.**

During the dark days of the Trump Administration, Donald Trump and his MAGA allies wasted no time undermining our democracy and disenfranchising voters.

Now, they’re trying to do it again by rewriting election rules in states like Georgia and Mississippi. _They know their only path to victory is through cheating._

[**I refuse to go back to those days. If you feel the same, will you chip in $5 to the Voter Protection Project to replace MAGA Republicans with Voting Rights Champions like VP Harris who will protect voting rights?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75965?t=8&akid=16328%2E878179%2EpAfLEB)

[**Please, chip in whatever you can today. Together, we can ensure that come November, we have a Congress and Senate full of Democratic champions who will fight for our voting rights.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/75965?t=14&akid=16328%2E878179%2EpAfLEB)

Now, it’s time to get to work. | | | Peter, Minutes ago, Kamala Harris officially accepted the Democratic Party’s nomination for President. Now, it’s time to get to work. The road ahead will be tough. But electing Kamala Harris and Tim Walz to the White House is a VITAL step toward our goal of blocking Trump’s authoritarian ambitions and winning real power for working families. Now is not the time to ease off the gas pedal. Donald Trump and the MAGA cronies he surrounds himself with should not be underestimated. Elections are hard to win. Elections against liars and bullies funded by the billionaire class are even harder. It is going to take every ounce of effort, from each and every one of us, to defeat MAGA and Trump in November. And it will take even more work — both leading up to and following the election — to BUILD governing power for working people and get closer to a world where working families come first. A world where we defeat the global authoritarian right-wing movement, including in Israel and Palestine, where the Netanyahu government has killed more than forty-thousand men, women, and children, and displaced or starved millions more. A world that ensures health care, clean air, and quality housing for all. A world that guarantees the right to vote without discrimination, to love who we love, and to control our own bodies. Defeating Donald Trump 74 days from now brings us one step closer to this world. And although it will be a grueling challenge, we CAN do it if we stick together. In solidarity, Team WFP Thoughts? clean_body: Kamala Harris knows that this is one of the most important elections in our lifetimes. | | | | I just watched Kamala Harris accept the Democratic nomination for President of the United States, and it was exhilarating! = Tonight, Kamala's acceptance speech was filled with joy and hope, but it didn't downplay the stakes in this election, either. Kamala Harris knows that this is one of the most important elections in our lifetimes. It's not hyperbolic to say that. Donald Trump is a generational destructive candidate running on a dangerous platform that would take our country backward. We're not going to stop fighting because I'm hopeful for our future, and I know that the American people will make the right choice in November. New Jerseyans are fired up to elect a new generation of leadership – one that will focus on creating change instead of chaos and hate. Alongside Vice President Kamala Harris, I'm fighting for working families. We can make progress and further lower costs for our working families. We can build a care economy to make sure that our kids and our elderly have the help they need. We can make the American Dream affordable and accessible to every single New Jerseyan. Saturday, August 24 \- Bring a Friend to a Meet and Greet! Sunday, August 25 \- Grab Your Walking Shoes and Meet Your Neighbors in Gurnee! Can't Make it But Want to Help with Voter Outreach? Our campaign is committed to reaching every voter, but voter outreach is costly. Every phone call, door knock, and mailer adds up. That's why we're asking for your support. Whether you can give $5, $50, or whatever you can afford, every contribution makes a difference. Your support ensures we can continue connecting with voters and spreading our message. Please chip in today--together, we can make a real impact! Thank you for your support!Julia Team Carris Follow Jim's Campaign on Social Media |

name: Sarah DeValkenaere
subject: It’s so hard to be a cop these days
body:
Dear Friend,

I wish I could sit down with you face to face instead of writing this e-mail.
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zle4b9r5o2u58vkaftsrilavusifsf80fbl8lkf8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g66pj6c5h2bs)
That's a picture of me and my husband, Eric, so you at least know what we look like.

Eric is a Detective with the Kansas City Police Department.

I wanted to send a picture of us with our three beautiful children - but in this current political climate, I don't feel safe sharing photos of our kids on the Internet.

When I tell you what happened, I think you'll understand. **[And I pray that you'll find it in your heart to help me save my husband.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj0tfijgh6bqhktobfk1r3u7h01dcdfq2m9sctq8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g66pj6c5h2bs)**

You see, it all started in early December - a few weeks before Christmas.

One of Eric's fellow detectives witnessed two vehicles speeding through the city streets - one was clearly chasing the other - and the police helicopter quickly got involved. A spotter in the helicopter was able to locate the suspect in a red pickup truck... still speeding down city streets.

The driver, 26-year-old Cameron Lamb, was chasing his ex-girlfriend in a stolen truck - weaving across lanes and running through stoplights.

My husband and his partner responded to the call and caught up with the suspect as he attempted to back the stolen truck into a garage.

Both detectives got out of their police vehicles and approached the stolen truck while repeatedly ordering the suspect to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS.

That's when it happened.

**As Eric 's partner approached the driver's side, the suspect reached into his waistband and pulled out a handgun - pointing it directly at the detective.**

**My husband 's police training kicked in.**

He fired four rounds in the direction of the suspect through the truck's front windshield. The truck continued traveling into the garage where it finally came to a stop.

When officers entered, they found the suspect deceased - his arm hanging out the open window with a .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground below.

That night, when Eric returned home, I hugged him and burst into tears. I was so thankful he was safe - and hopeful we could move forward and put this episode behind us.

But it didn't end there.

Several months later, the local prosecutor _charged Eric with MANSLAUGHTER and Armed Criminal Action._

I was in shock.

Then late last year, my husband finally went to trial. The judge ruled against him - and Eric was sentenced to 6 years in prison.

Now you understand why I'm asking for your help.

My husband is an honest man of integrity who followed in his father's law enforcement footsteps. Eric himself is a decorated, 21-year veteran of the Kansas City Police Department.

He's a role model in our community - a Little League baseball coach, a tireless volunteer, and a loving husband and father.

My husband is a hero.

But it didn't matter to the prosecutor that the suspect recklessly swerved a stolen truck through city streets... that he was violent toward his ex-girlfriend and endangered the lives of her two children... that he pointed a stolen gun directly at a police officer.

For serving our community for over 20 years - and risking his life - my has been shipped to an out-of-state prison.

And since the Missouri Supreme Court recently declined to take up Eric's case, that's where he'll stay for the next six years unless he receives a pardon from the Governor of Missouri. He'll miss our wedding anniversaries, our children's birthdays, their graduations(?), and our home will be left without the father and husband we love.

Even if Eric's good name is eventually cleared, just thinking about the cost of his defense and now our efforts to get him pardoned is overwhelming...

... but thank God we got a call from Jason Johnson, President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

If you've ever heard of LELDF you know they're a national group fighting on behalf of wrongly accused police officers like Eric.

LELDF has helped dozens of innocent cops - and their families - at their lowest moments.

And with the thought of trying to suddenly raise our three children alone - I was certainly at one of the lowest moments of my life.

Not only did the LELDF board decide to help provide Eric with the best possible legal defense, but now they're helping us launch a nationwide petition campaign urging Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric.

But as a non-profit organization, they depend solely on generous gifts from folks like you to defend officers like Eric.

I truly believe God is using Jason and the LELDF to answer our prayers.

That's because my husband and I are not wealthy people. I'm a kindergarten teacher and Eric is a career cop.

So I must ask you one of the toughest questions I've ever asked anyone.

**Will you donate[$35 or any amount to LELDF today to help save my husband?](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd96p1mc48tfesoikpoqbgg54f6uig9djl62l2l8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g66pj6c5h2bs)**

If I had anywhere else to turn, I wouldn't be so bold as to ask for your help.

But I am so scared for Eric and I will do whatever I can for him - and for our children.

**[So I pray you'll find it in your heart today to make a tax-deductible gift of $35, $50, $100 or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9fhh3mp2p7034if7sm0jk6285nht0srmg48eqm0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g66pj6c5h2bs)**

Eric and I - and our three kids - are counting on the good nature and generosity of kind neighbors like you to help bring Eric home where he belongs.

No matter what you're able to give today, please pray for us. Thank you in advance for your support.

Sincerely,

Sarah DeValkenaere

P.S. The Missouri Supreme Court has declined to take Eric's case. Now a pardon is one of the last remaining options to bring Eric home. We're feverishly trying to raise the money to pay for a massive petition drive urging the Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon Eric. I know my husband is innocent. But it's so hard to be a cop these days. The 'defund the police' movement has wiped out the support officers like Eric need to do their jobs.

And dozens of prosecutors across the country have made it a priority to try and lock up as many cops as they can. Even if they followed their training or defended themselves in the line of duty. The brave men and women in blue need to know that someone... anyone still has their back.

**[That's why I sincerely hope you'll help me get justice for Eric - and our entire family - by making a tax-deductible gift of any amount to the LELDF today.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zb5c7ffjk2k2l212ln4krkmhlbk2oe3j8segv258_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g66pj6c5h2bs)**

Thank you, and God bless!
--------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember -Blue Lives Matter!_

name: Hillsdale College via Trump News HQ
subject: Defending liberty is even more urgent
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Trump Train News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zm0s4olbs4asikhani5rpqqt46f0oc29e1lc70so_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5g6eoj5c3h2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We have to go back to how our Founding Fathers designed the U.S. Congress if we're going to understand this fully. Thankfully, Hillsdale College created our free online course, **" Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn't," **to do just that.** **
---

You can get your DVD box set of **" Congress: How It Worked and Why It Doesn't"** right away with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more.

name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zr31c1u7ajo27s4ks1b9rqpgqgv1dr2g0upo30ko_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i60o72c1h2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zbdtcq4buqrrmhecdti9oimmoe1dpir4hl1onut8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i60o72c1h2bs).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zkgjip09mq5dfjvsc8bb8tvjhh8te1s4vf77bh80_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i60o72c1h2bs)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpuifmnfdl794713i0h8b6eq9d6isr6v342vv0a8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i60o72c1h2bs)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---

I wish things would have gone a different way...
| **_Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control._**
---

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

subject: Revisionists are trying to change America’sroots
body:
I invite you to read America Is a Christian Nation to understand how our country has shifted from its reliance on God to a rejection of God

| | | [](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z67a116a13rbo4h1prudaocbr0ds67d45rreql5o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i6cpb4cdh2bs)
---
[](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z0hhofpb50fu3ld3qecokf1mt5kjr07214j1ig70_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i6cpb4cdh2bs) Hello Friend, ____ Some people today would have you believe that our nation was founded on secular principles, insisting that "a great wall of separation between Church and State" has always been our guiding principle. They claim that the founders intended for Christianity to be completely absent from all forms of government.

These assertions are false, and I can prove it. In fact, I have demonstrated it in my book America Is a Christian Nation, using the words and actions of the founders themselves.

The truth is that, over time, secularists, humanists, and atheists have distorted our Constitution into something the founding fathers never intended.

I invite you to read _America Is a Christian Nation_ to understand how our country has shifted from its reliance on God to a rejection of God--and how we can return to those roots of dependence on Him.

It's a concise read, beautifully complemented by stunning patriotic photos that you'll be sure to enjoy.

To express our appreciation for any gift you can make to _Pathway to Victory_ today, we'd like to send you a copy of this book. I know you'll find it both informative and engaging.

You can receive your copy of _America Is a Christian Nation_ by making your matched donation here: [https://secure.ptv.org/america-is-a-christian-nation-generous-gift-1](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2z9vtpicv8t19jr0ds58oiorac5pnl9vt5dt6tclo_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5i6cpb4cdh2bs)

As believers, we need to do all we can to preserve America's unique heritage and fight for our religious freedoms. I hope you'll join me in this important work.

Thank you for your support of this ministry.

Sincerely,

Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
This is how we’re fighting back...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

By now, you’re probably familiar with Vice President Kamala Harris’ choice of running mate.

(Not that I'm surprised), but she opted for the far-Left, radically pro-abortion Minnesota Governor Tim Walz, making this the most rabidly pro-abortion ticket in American history.

As Governor or Minnesota, Tim Walz signed legislation REMOVING the requirement that babies who are born alive after botched abortions receive medical care.

After doing so, **at least eight babies were born alive** during botched abortions in his state. And all eight of them died brutal, preventable deaths gasping for oxygen “thanks” to Governor Walz. This is the truth about the Harris-Walz ticket.

They want babies treated like garbage, and then thrown away.

name: Hillsdale College via Freedom Nation Today
subject: Liberty Under Threat
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=717a23a4570045b980c4cdcd0337fb13&_e=BD8rUIIl74wigzmsRvmo1gpEapJXSgUSckQ31Zab_o6_hpPRJ6v-0XSAO1tVlwpjCPWEkGPLQpG8oBeMNu5eF9QxOqjt7W1SGlshS8weSYxxPSAeKKrUS_ZVFl78KTOq6R_0YNW7uRFFT-qjliNrxwN3GxpewCC9VC7HSgXoHv_H_AhovTEUFCU2QulvC_bM_zwB4iMgmyPFyj0A1dzcLKSmxwhL_5nNVlnhMtTycdIF6mApUhHUMAFnu7DiYyGl9Su1oXsdcTNEDRnr4vEFD7ipfjVLMYZCRhiPdcsgsv3MHUq0d19CIkJIVt6LLfb1FtSZJMOKeqLr--3ngYoDu-aiJrLTPns70huHZQZZYk2tFRdEaCVuhFOHjqA7hRDQ46Vi6Gl2dG41JJKGw8kYww%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=717a23a4570045b980c4cdcd0337fb13&_e=BD8rUIIl74wigzmsRvmo1gpEapJXSgUSckQ31Zab_o6_hpPRJ6v-0XSAO1tVlwpjCPWEkGPLQpG8oBeMNu5eF9QxOqjt7W1SGlshS8weSYxxPSAeKKrUS_ZVFl78KTOq6R_0YNW7uRFFT-qjliNrxwN3GxpewCC9VC7HSgXoHv_H_AhovTEUFCU2QulvC_bM_zwB4iMgmyPFyj0A1dzcLKSmxwhL_5nNVlnhMtTycdIF6mApUhHUMAFnu7DiYyGlc7vgHhyHTQRVl80mlOtir5IGW1K6NqJ7tc-B-es-FBXq4ra5lGTi9-t-yAGMqTYH2LDANf2Knim31sxqfj7QMYkWqUJ2yQPWvA4Mk1ni2MWqG-aqTO3fZrFSJOw_o6Oyzamko8wT7DyS8pDFKT1l5g%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=717a23a4570045b980c4cdcd0337fb13&_e=BD8rUIIl74wigzmsRvmo1gpEapJXSgUSckQ31Zab_o6_hpPRJ6v-0XSAO1tVlwpjCPWEkGPLQpG8oBeMNu5eF9QxOqjt7W1SGlshS8weSYxxPSAeKKrUS_ZVFl78KTOq6R_0YNW7uRFFT-qjliNrxwN3GxpewCC9VC7HSgXoHv_H_AhovTEUFCU2QulvC_bM_zwB4iMgmyPFyj0A1dzcLKSmxwhL_5nNVlnhMtTycdIF6mApUhHUMAFnu7DiYyGliS5prHmq4huoikW-fU7NOyttzVNEvJ_74mzzK0z6K8ZgFU_fW2RkYHu3Kb658Olf9YVBtU6wVyB9-nMxRx9gYm3owpRKFbxoB-g7aUN3AOGHHs6ozhY59yrquW9oK6NADJUCeVWPvzYnFmWq-Pecpg%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=717a23a4570045b980c4cdcd0337fb13&_e=BD8rUIIl74wigzmsRvmo1gpEapJXSgUSckQ31Zab_o6_hpPRJ6v-0XSAO1tVlwpjCPWEkGPLQpG8oBeMNu5eF9QxOqjt7W1SGlshS8weSYxxPSAeKKrUS_ZVFl78KTOq6R_0YNW7uRFFT-qjliNrxwN3GxpewCC9VC7HSgXoHv_H_AhovTEUFCU2QulvC_bM_zwB4iMgmyPFyj0A1dzcLKSmxwhL_5nNVlnhMtTycdIF6mApUhHUMAFnu7DiYyGlkefYFpaYlRf1trHpZ5U3JpqUo_1qufemTg3kaFV2hIYMErrsYyFW2Xwl1BItRPmws7DHLBV1T47jjJLQ2EGya9N5qyspqUxygrUJvT4bsz1idX47iSN1r_6P4ldau0ErAzTB2ajKJeuk7hQmIIdLqw%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College | | | | | Fellow American, Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear. Together, these forces want to circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity , and push their own false and dishonest narrative about American history and about what's happening today. We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America! The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities. It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley. We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education. Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem. A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty. Hillsdale launched Imprimis over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective. Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, Imprimis is more critical than ever. Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments. On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is simply and clearly un-American. There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says Imprimis is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month. You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are mailed to homes and businesses ten times per year. Our research also shows that Imprimis subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving Imprimis even greater reach and influence. And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--Imprimis has a greater circulation than the Wall Street Journal and The New York Times --we are determined to do more. Since Imprimis launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription. But the fact that we offer Imprimis free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing Imprimis is without cost. Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of Imprimis to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking. Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of Imprimis to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs. Your generous support today will help us reach our Imprimis goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts. You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever! That's why, in addition to Imprimis , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our . Educating thousands of K-12 students in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics. I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for Imprimis and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable. Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to reach and teach increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government. Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation. This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. ? ## Kamala Harris Accepts Nomination
Vice President Kamala Harris [accepted the Democratic nomination](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7turTAURL_G7ozM9ubhwsVt6M5tU6J9_Dg4MRgZB5K_j0idbqQZzdJ6e8wPiilur_-0elNDnsnWePp5FKAE4IzcmeA9eMW9aQdABKlR8cWgVu6JIZAnq_vh6brQa9Jgu4Hc2GkeDUhAOYJqpewRGq2lCiBl22trYUSG0rtYc2nec9zq4kP6zqcvjc0rT2apdT-Y-sdgYjBd19XQV8zH3TKY7m8GkxzvrBhMH7RSIrFQKfEQbrPinohaPtedF-P2K6YUj35gKF8rxfSLqX9LnwZ-AgAA__-Uz1bE) for president Thursday night, giving a roughly 40-minute speech promising to unite the nation while heavily criticizing former President Donald Trump.Harris was frequently interrupted by cheers and applause from the delegates as she highlighted her policy positions on health care, voting rights, and social security and promised a middle-class tax cut for 100 million Americans.In the area of foreign policy, [Harris stated her support](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsj7FuwyAQQL8Gb0THQYk9MHTxlq4drSs-x1dhsDB11H59lc4dn97w9N5v040kSb6_0cahLWWi2OTkqddoNbrJdXNYmJFtx8Fc0TmEwdluDRA9-A9zhRfvTI9sl95YQy72vLD3cycBAR30aA2Ad3gZBrALAhg_xIi9Uw54llbq5bNIbisv6bucXC-xbF0Ka2v7oeyrwlHhSHvmx_FUCsckJyscv_aZGh965q3ESk2iztSkZEo6lnxyfoJeqVY59IPST1fDvD8kJTn8VTm4byTpr9f-vz8D_gYAAP__UpVdZw) for Ukraine, NATO, and Israel while also backing Palestine's right to exist.Throughout the speech, Harris attacked former President Trump for his policies while repeatedly calling for unity and describing the country as ready to move forward.
## Canada Rail Strike Threatens U.S.
A rail labor dispute in Canada has [shut down](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEbLejFQuHgN0ityzRVXog0s4MjYkfElyt-fcvXVU8xovi7ThX3wcfvgQ1xZ08Rz8Q-Zeo1GI01ULW4VQTGVuKZDIoSBTLW7jom4NZbbfh0aC0TXloy9tlbEdNxU3iEgQY-mAbCE9TCAWRGgscM8Y0-KQBZfUq5vyceyyxpe6SG5ntNRBbeXcj-V-adwVDjydY7yPOstvbHC8X8skiMXnyIHhePTZ_ksKb8UjjNHXvjUqA--pazXLH7bi87sQ068nHr9DkGfJd319lbGQ2LRTWPAAkBfZbfcnz4Ef9pOEWwH-_CbVf6e9HD4EwAA__84G2mI)[ freight traffic](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGOqzAQAL_GdEbLejFQuHgN0ityzRVXog0s4MjYkfElyt-fcvXVU8xovi7ThX3wcfvgQ1xZ08Rz8Q-Zeo1GI01ULW4VQTGVuKZDIoSBTLW7jom4NZbbfh0aC0TXloy9tlbEdNxU3iEgQY-mAbCE9TCAWRGgscM8Y0-KQBZfUq5vyceyyxpe6SG5ntNRBbeXcj-V-adwVDjydY7yPOstvbHC8X8skiMXnyIHhePTZ_ksKb8UjjNHXvjUqA--pazXLH7bi87sQ068nHr9DkGfJd319lbGQ2LRTWPAAkBfZbfcnz4Ef9pOEWwH-_CbVf6e9HD4EwAA__84G2mI) on the country's two largest railways, threatening crucial supply chains across North America.The shutdown, which began after [a failed negotiation](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLtuwzAMAL_G3hxQFK3HoKFLtnTtaNCUnKhVbEMWkvbvi3TueLjhgPu4TBfOJa_Xd76n0JZtYmn5kSY3oB6QJupjWFLCpPsUlEUiBE-6vwXv0crMdtTKOWdG1NGjiTB7qzQ51eeAgAQOtQIwhCfvQS8IoIwXQUcdQYq5bfX0ueW13dJSfrZHqifZ7n0Jt9b2o9NvHZ47PPO-pufxUi-oLUtJHZ6FV448VM6lbhyPQfYvGeT4HsbZo4eZLEcjcSbtrR5FwWjAAEbd1xD3Zy4lH8Z2BNc75_KXbv-PeAT8DQAA__-p-1wF) with the Teamsters union, has disrupted the transport of over $1 billion in goods daily and affected more than 30,000 commuters in major Canadian cities.The prolonged dispute could have [significant economic impacts](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsjz1vhSAUQH8NbM9cL5SPgaGL2-va0SBenjQIRonGf9-8zt1OcpKTnO_n-PQpp_L68iu5FuvoQ0snjeaB4oFylHx2kQhJcHK9RikRrBR8cbY3WgYNmsjojwmU0r3WIU4etLEm8uQQUIJB0QMoiZ21ICIC9MqGgEYyCTSnVvfup6bSFor5riftXagrz25pbTuY-GQ4MByu6-qmKbwdw6HQdTAc_N5SyPTGcGtVynbvJVe-u3m7Us7pUJpJeK0-5b9q-__xdPgbAAD__8qEUn8) on Canada and the U.S., potentially disrupting shipments of goods ranging from grains and beans to potash, coal, and timber.

## New Poll Shows Tight Races for President, Senate
A new poll conducted by the University of Houston and Texas Southern University shows tight margins among Texas voters in the races for president and U.S. Senate. In [the presidential race](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0j7FuwyAUAL_GbFiPBzZmYOiSLV07WmCeExRsIkNN-vdVs3c_3em-rvPVxRT326fbyNbXmme31HjSPHGUHNWsWLAeghGMrNColBj0MLK7JfIjTFKJAM5oNGE1UqEWEMy4TsKzaBFQwYRSwDDKqR88LMsKznsfhF5Cp4BCrPno650qvVxZ008-6eiXvLFk77U-Syc_Orx0eGmt9Tu10ogef0CHl5B3lwKvx_f25EcsD55yifuNv2VcGIUGkB02PFtMKZZRdwpum4vpnaj_HJ8WfwMAAP__CCdZaQ), 49.5% of likely voters back Donald Trump, while 44.6% support Kamala Harris. Only 2% plan to vote for Robert F. Kennedy Jr. In [the U.S. Senate race](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2OgzAQhJ_GdEbexeancHENXa69Eq3tdbDkQAQOJG9_SqprrhvNaDSj7-cyXSjltFy_6ca2POM6kS_p4KmX2EjUk66CdSoMULGFDrUG05m2mi34ART0xgdUQwsUUffYBINdxCYiV8miQq16bECZtulr45T3UZFzLkDng9CKQyrrVpeZCz9pj_m1HrzVfr1V2c6l3HfRfAkcBY7nedZnJHqHAkfaSvKZBY4Ln7vA8b7mVJJ_y4VKWhfK8o_3mGXZH3J_bAe_5GdNHmvhbZec2b8LAkfsjTQADA562RhNUuuB5aC8kQwRHDk1-KiqzYb7mXJOe9sJra43Svlzu_xD8bD4GwAA__-pOHQU), 46.6% of likely voters expressed support for Republican incumbent Ted Cruz, compared to 44.5% who back Democratic challenger Colin Allred. On Wednesday, [Cruz was endorsed](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kLuO6yAUAL8Gd1hwzMMpKG7jLrfd0uJxSNBiYwGJs_v1q2y_5WiKkebjul5tymm__bcbmv6KZbW-pyeuM4WJgljFEIxj4cIHNFyDEFxqqYa70Y57ryZ3idEFUFEx6SUqtEp74eZ5SAYYCDbDxJlU0zxKx7yPzDrnAtc-EMEwpF7q2O_Y8WVbzF_liXX0ZRuyufd-NDL9I7AQWM7zHD97296SwLLj2Qgsj0aPklNP_k2u1ICVHrbXkuljT2WnuIdSGzbq6-ObwDJUE44z5Zya0kSw22ZT_i32PwY8DfwEAAD__3hwYHc) by the union representing U.S. Border Patrol agents, many of whom support his stance of cracking down on illegal immigration. Allred, meanwhile, has criticized Cruz for blocking immigration reform efforts in Congress.
## DPS Blocks Sex Changes On Driver's Licenses
Texans who identify as transgender can no longer [change the sex](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2O4yAUhZ8Gd1j48mOnoNjGXbbd0gLutY2W4AiQnXn7UaJppz2fztHR9---3F1MMW9_3YNse63H4kKLJy0TB8lBLapD6wXeho7sMIJSgx616XYL3jm5Bo3GoxxBr4M3N5q8UEoHFFMXLQhQYgI5CG3k1GsvQliF897jMAZkShDGdpS-7dTo5eqavo6TSh-OR5fs3tqzMvmHwcxgvq6rzz7ger0xgznTVRnM6QguMZg_A_wnbMXlulFGKvwNcuU-HeE_IccSTyo8xUC5Eg-7yxu9O9LAaCQwmLti8XnFlGI1I1Nie7iYPqfaL45OC98BAAD__yBGa0c) on their driver's licenses, even with a certified court order or amended birth certificate, due to a recent Texas Department of Public Safety policy change. The change was prompted by concerns from Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton about the [authenticity of such court orders](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJx0kL2SpCAQx58Gs57CFkc2MLiEbC-9cAqbVruOgSlgde_tr5x8sw5-_f_68_n49BIlbb_9k-f2veaHpyYHPyzgAGgepgvzosNH3_HcT2hMP07jvdvn3gx3Zk1kKdjV-t4i-tF80DgFa0bdyYwajbY49Hq8D_Y2Lppo1X5ZltBPFJTRHKTlcms7N_72dY3_8sHlRvnZxXlv7VXV8EuhU-jO87xRFPqLe_6qLaeLUugSn1Whi5l8VOguT4VO2-vuFbrwqpAyxJw2LuCJ-NUkbUD5qzTIJXCpkAv4J6fAARYpbQfi0mQV8o0rtAy0-7QxbBdTICd454VQ5Lj-oxCnym8hCQpdV-bwOiVGqfdJGb09vcR3r_bDzMeM_wMAAP__jLyC3w). | [](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjM2LWFkNGJlN2U0YmNiOTQyNmQ5MjcyOGVjOGY1NzEyNmYzIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjAiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvZGVwYXJ0bWVudC1vZi1qdXN0aWNlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEwNDBOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWRvanN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TQ1lfQUUtTExPNTM3NzgifQ/TbnBaDNxBxjOP2_p6YCuRA) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://trk.libertyledger.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MjE2Mjk1NiIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MjM2LWFkNGJlN2U0YmNiOTQyNmQ5MjcyOGVjOGY1NzEyNmYzIiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2xwLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvZGVwYXJ0bWVudC1vZi1qdXN0aWNlLXN1cnZleS8_c2M9MDEwNDBOMDI0MkwwQURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPWRvanN1cnZleSZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1TQ1lfQUUtTExPNTM3NzgifQ/t8iIaqArdqQ0AEOjQ1sU6w)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. subject: Join Hillsdale College in Defending Liberty
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Full Mag News is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdfa1f1c742744f990081ddd562c091d&_e=rCLTqHKBSlm4S0sFxw4SwI8BO5pyk-6zpzUkvwt506YU92c5NlhEOcQWaYsTCkt2tarTRVAebD9AdSMWsToVo0x9UoxdcsjimuCG23yaQG0vygXa-2OketAUcOEWu-4J_G7RuvBzllTTNW0S0I7UcTlB5UkL2CZSdSFLXcfmF80IW2O5ndA72gSSy3hu0xulnGUhEXULlurx7FbCOr82B-g0kuHgc8gwYPL_89th_aYYxheHS83-RBNNIKIPiwQoFCLD_6LneaiYRtXl2bGs2_O5VHFuUCVt66xihmDnIdIVVwF88QtAGdcQGGuBjEJg88lOD561ezfhiE58juTDTGzoPzr6VmwSFSg_UIIKyyWzz2KxiHAzAFg_GYKrBgqKXsxQ-IUdKK6h-OlErxSSkQ%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdfa1f1c742744f990081ddd562c091d&_e=rCLTqHKBSlm4S0sFxw4SwI8BO5pyk-6zpzUkvwt506YU92c5NlhEOcQWaYsTCkt2tarTRVAebD9AdSMWsToVo0x9UoxdcsjimuCG23yaQG0vygXa-2OketAUcOEWu-4J_G7RuvBzllTTNW0S0I7UcTlB5UkL2CZSdSFLXcfmF80IW2O5ndA72gSSy3hu0xulnGUhEXULlurx7FbCOr82B-g0kuHgc8gwYPL_89th_aYYxheHS83-RBNNIKIPiwQoKxpDn2os3ro8bhNZ-8qcrYCYRV8N7_AUTfahdQb-XrpZrSZwMObBXB5I1xmkLCOQbkhNlmW-qYD6xsRVUOL1zcM0LHrIeGT5nRP5zG1PtGZeIPDUt9EiO76aeWEU6k-8bsm2QNh0LC4lrD81K3R62w%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdfa1f1c742744f990081ddd562c091d&_e=rCLTqHKBSlm4S0sFxw4SwI8BO5pyk-6zpzUkvwt506YU92c5NlhEOcQWaYsTCkt2tarTRVAebD9AdSMWsToVo0x9UoxdcsjimuCG23yaQG0vygXa-2OketAUcOEWu-4J_G7RuvBzllTTNW0S0I7UcTlB5UkL2CZSdSFLXcfmF80IW2O5ndA72gSSy3hu0xulnGUhEXULlurx7FbCOr82B-g0kuHgc8gwYPL_89th_aYYxheHS83-RBNNIKIPiwQoucKcq6vb246gJQU43aoZNVJh-n8iRP8Tg1CGSXtri70AVpgYd_Fl1Ohhw1zkmT2qnyawbOYLaNUUR-1c27XKkKZlEHVlVFILt1bqXYCtWeEN3Qys9GIA_a8bwSlAXq_YqoIM3fDlK8ifaTHPC5-kNQ%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://links.fullmagnews.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=fdfa1f1c742744f990081ddd562c091d&_e=rCLTqHKBSlm4S0sFxw4SwI8BO5pyk-6zpzUkvwt506YU92c5NlhEOcQWaYsTCkt2tarTRVAebD9AdSMWsToVo0x9UoxdcsjimuCG23yaQG0vygXa-2OketAUcOEWu-4J_G7RuvBzllTTNW0S0I7UcTlB5UkL2CZSdSFLXcfmF80IW2O5ndA72gSSy3hu0xulnGUhEXULlurx7FbCOr82B-g0kuHgc8gwYPL_89th_aYYxheHS83-RBNNIKIPiwQoPnQlbfvcMTnkh68Hwt6oGeiYr6SugMzsRARAYHQC3Y0wGR9_MLLxjXkCJynMTMgCij9_ndpMITjWxPsqlbLFo1ieCjp-ukO3XwIsuFSA4OkIiKPZeDXgEM12gM364pSZg2rWwo3KenZr9x4jY8yjBQ%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
