I want to take a moment to remind you of my journey to the U.S. Senate, the important lessons I have learned along the way, and why I continue to believe wholeheartedly in our beloved state.

My father, a World War II veteran, left school during the Great Depression to join the Army. Though he only had a ninth grade education, he built a career as a hard-working cement finisher. My mother, a dedicated voter who never missed an election, instilled in me the importance of civic duty.

From my parents, I inherited an unwavering love for this country that I have proudly carried throughout my life. It's something I strive to keep alive in Wyoming.

Later, in medical school, I learned the importance of having a plan before taking action, a lesson that has proven invaluable in both my medical career and my service as your senator. Just as in surgery, effective leadership requires a clear vision and a strategic approach to problem-solving.

As you may know, I am sometimes referred to as "Wyoming's doctor," but to be honest, that is what I have always strived to be as your senator. I have wholeheartedly dedicated myself to serving the state, addressing its challenges, and making it the best it can be.

Whether it's advocating for our veterans, championing American energy security, or safeguarding our borders, I've always strived to be a voice for all Wyoming people. Your concerns are my concerns, and your aspirations are my aspirations.

As we look towards the future, I'm confident that Wyoming has the potential to be an even stronger, more prosperous state.
https://click.join.barrassoforwyoming.com/?qs=4b19f16dd4fdfca57b3a97aaee5c9cd62d5e83772b480844a80d04ccf290739cf5b9335410cead2ef0fa9fc5d6a4f24b760375c0ee2d450b29ba809ba942456f
But it will require strong leadership, a clear vision, and your continued support.

Already, your support has been instrumental in my journey, and I promise to continue fighting for the issues that matter most to Wyoming families.

Sincerely,

Senator John Barrasso

# FROM THE DESK OF LARRY KUDLOW
---
| | Peter,**I am pleased to share with you that The New York Sun, one of my daily must-read papers, is now the exclusive publisher of my regular columns.

I invite you to consider joining the Sun to receive unlimited access to my latest commentary, alongside some of the finest American journalism.

**But there's also far more to what the Sun is building.

As you know, journalism isn't what it used to be.

I've been in the business for decades, and never before have I seen this once noble profession so abused. The major papers are no longer on the side of the American people, and we are right to withhold our trust.

The impact on our democracy is considerable. Without real accountability, the worst actors in government and at corporate institutions have free reign, and patriotic, hard-working Americans are being sidelined and ignored.

The antidote is to join the movement to build a better alternative. That's the American way.

**The charge to restore American journalism is being led by the Sun.** A proudly all-American, principled publication that has plenty of room for conservative thought and conservative writers, the Sun has upheld the highest journalistic standards since 1833. That's 18 years before the New York Times published its first number.**My decision for the New York Sun to become the exclusive publisher of my regular columns was not taken lightly.**

I value their work and have been impressed by their team, but I know they have a hell of a battle ahead. They are the David facing many Goliaths.

They will only succeed if we join with them in this grassroots national effort. Joining the Sun costs as little as a penny a day. I encourage you to sign up today. Every single person counts.

Her story reminds me a lot of my own, growing up in a two room house in Tallahassee with six brothers and sisters. Debbie and I know what it's like to work hard and persevere — and we appreciate the freedom and possibility that makes America so wonderful.

Hello,
It’s been 5 years since Trump made the corrupt phone call that forever altered the lives of me and my twin brother.
On July 25, 2019, my brother Alexander Vindman listened as President Trump attempted to extort our ally Ukraine, a country at war, by withholding military aid unless President Zelenskyy investigated Joe Biden.
At the time, I was serving as the senior ethics official at the National Security Council in the White House. After Alex reported the call to me, my brother and I made the fateful decision to do our patriotic duty and stand up to Donald Trump at the risk of our decades-long military careers.
We blew the whistle on him and reported his corrupt phone call with Ukraine up the chain of command. Our actions eventually led to his impeachment, and Trump retaliated by firing us from our posts.
The decision to blow the whistle on Donald Trump cost my brother and me our military careers. But over two decades ago, I swore an oath to protect our country and our Constitution from threats, foreign and domestic, and I would not let Trump deter me from that duty.
So I decided to run for Congress in Virginia to fight back against Trump and the far-right Republicans who enable his abuse of power and attacks on our Democracy.
But this race is one of the most competitive in the country, and my MAGA opponent has the backing of Trump and his millions of dollars. It’s not going to be easy to win.

Dr. Robert Jeffress

body:
Last night, Gabby delivered a powerful speech at the Democratic National Convention
#

Hi team, we wanted to make sure you saw Gabby’s note from last night after she delivered a powerful speech at the Democratic National Convention.
[**Please, keep scrolling to read Gabby’s message, and then use this link to chip in to GIFFORDS PAC today to help us in our work to elect Vice President Kamala Harris and Governor Tim Walz as the next president and vice president of the United States.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240823-1-BL&t=1&akid=8772%2E3935704%2E6zYm6m)
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240823-1-BL&t=2&akid=8772%2E3935704%2E6zYm6m)**
\- Team GIFFORDS
* * *
Friends -
**I just got off the stage at the Democratic National Convention in Chicago, where I had the opportunity to share my story with millions of Americans.**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-aug24.hBGz9O&refcode=em240823-1-BL&t=3&akid=8772%2E3935704%2E6zYm6m)
I was born in the great state of Arizona. I grew up racing motorcycles, mucking stalls, and exploring the beautiful desert.
For five years, I served in Congress from a swing district. Everybody called me a rising star. Then, on January 8th, 2011, a man tried to assassinate me. He shot 19 people. He killed six.
It was a terrible, terrible day.
I almost died, but I fought for my life, and I survived. I learned to walk again, one step at a time. I learned to talk again, one word at a time.
I bring this same grit and determination to our work here at GIFFORDS PAC—work that has saved countless lives from gun violence over the past eleven years.
The energy in Chicago tonight is tangible. There is a renewed hope for our democracy, and I’m sure you can feel it too. My friend Kamala Harris will be a great president. She is ready to serve, and she will be a steadfast partner in our movement for gun safety.

I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.

But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.

**All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.**
******Right now, we’re building the largest grassroots team Texas has ever seen to defeat Ted Cruz and flip Texas blue. But he’s got an army of right-wing donors and far-right super PACs behind him, and I can’t win this race without your support.**

[**So please, if you're ready to defeat Ted Cruz, bring real leadership to Texas, and defend our narrow Senate majority, will you rush a split donation of $25 or whatever you can afford between me and The Collective PAC right now?**](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtxV2SCukgR7U0FmW9XFjbA8pxEnoc9nbHVW4adMC15fDtO1r3f94fxiIB2oB0X7tXFJ30UKrHl2pnM1se4qq75-tYrNgtq8aTrDZTle33FpBK27J639RW1MKtLfCgdH_dLm1J0pAbtsGLpxQJMQVGgtTsmASq2dcRM8NytecPjyBPOOeEiVujKJBPRS7_v595S2XViG-mj1ciEsId_Exc8I0u1chEDRKhHtKrkxCsqp-rOeGfSFVzo9u_T1xFNGqfL6h9Ua0tPLerlpLzg4iTIL81m4ta4qG18fFAeSHCh2JYa4JHxtfNfO8TGPcbAgNHo8EsO42dxinTjDKOpQ3Lu9EYan8f3mnlF5PmwfL_thiAfMy5B_yyEo8mkd7kWQIxB5--D12O5oDFGBePc6KkMKu1ZwlYXHeDVpx3mog4mRQ/495/4EaYF4RpRHuTxSkPnRDAPg/h5/h001.SXlARJrlSsmkvJC5_ga1T_y_aO7UAxgHRhlVk0CDnMU)

August 23, 2024
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
CONTACT: Houston Keene
press@nancyforalaska.com

Statement from Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom

ANCHORAGE, AK - Lt. Governor Nancy Dahlstrom issued the following
statement:
"For over 20 years my commitment has been to do what is best for
Alaska. That commitment has been my North Star since the start of this
race.

I entered this race because Alaskans deserve better representation than
what we have received from Mary Peltola in Washington.

We know that Mary Peltola certainly isn't up to the challenge. She has
shown this.

At this time, the best thing I can do to see that goal realized is to
withdraw my name from the general election ballot and end my campaign.

I want to thank all those who have supported my campaign throughout
this process. I want to thank Governor Dunleavy for realizing and
focusing on the endless potential of Alaska. I want to thank President
Trump for recognizing the strength of not only Alaska, but her people.
And I want to thank Speaker Johnson, Leader Scalise, Whip Emmer,
Chairwoman Stefanik, and Congressman Hudson for their commitment to our
country, and Alaska's role in fulfilling the American Dream.

Thank you to the people of our incredible state for believing in me and
fighting with me. I'm so grateful to be an Alaskan and thankful to
Alaska herself for all that she has given me, my family, and our
country."

subject: What I told the crowd last night:
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
#

Peter, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention last night about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate.
[**And this morning, I am asking you to make a donation to my campaign — to defeat Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona and defend all the progress we have made together. Please, if you can afford it, chip in by using this link.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240823-1-160&t=1&akid=2935%2E734936%2ExZv2yq)
[DONATE $5](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240823-1-160&t=2&akid=2935%2E734936%2ExZv2yq)
My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.
Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.
But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve and to their families.
I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.
After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act in 2022 to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.
Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.
He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.
They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.
That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention last night, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.
But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter.
And today, I need your help.
[**Please, chip in $5 to my campaign this morning. Trump is rallying his supporters alongside Kari Lake tonight, and we have to raise a ton of resources to defeat them and defend Arizona.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-august24.kZit_I&refcode=em240823-1-160&t=3&akid=2935%2E734936%2ExZv2yq)

| We’ve officially entered the 75-day countdown to November 5, and thanks to your support, our campaign is stronger than ever.

Over the past six months, I’ve been working every day across the district, attending every fish fry, parade, and community event to meet the people of District Two.

One thing is clear in every conversation: Alabamians are ready to get this country back on the right track. People are struggling, and they want change from the status quo.

Last night, my opponent spoke at the DNC, fully embracing the Washington insider agenda and endorsing the platform of Kamala Harris. Once again, he’s shown that he’s not listening to the people of Alabama’s Second Congressional District or addressing the issues that keep them up at night. That’s why this fight is more important than ever.

As we head into the final stretch of this campaign, I need your help. We’ve got doors to knock, phone calls to make, signs to plant, and a message to spread.

Now is the time to talk to your friends, post on social media, and join the fight for lower prices, safer communities, and more opportunities for Alabamians.

Caroleene Dobson

| | | | folks, What a week it’s been! Chicago was the epicenter of hope and unity as the Democratic National Convention captivated the nation. The energy was palpable, and the message was clear: Democrats are ready to lead America toward a brighter future. Her powerful speech was the perfect conclusion to four days filled with impactful arguments for a better tomorrow. The atmosphere was electric, and it was a true celebration of what we stand for. But now, the final stretch to November 5th begins. The DNC has shown us that it’s time to mobilize to the MAX! We have the momentum, and we have the vision—but to win big this November, we need every Democrat to step up and make a difference. disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY CHRIS DELUZIO FOR CONGRESS
body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91363238/493614877/1895761198?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MjU0MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxZjNhZDMyMy01ODYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Cd9a1ScfwT7qiwiUtGRPThfs-rydbap-4h0A6NWELH0=&emci=2a2fca1d-5861-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&emdi=1f3ad323-5861-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ceid=13185894) Derek,

Elections are about choices and different visions of our future.

Last night, Vice President Kamala Harris laid out her vision for the future. And let me tell you, Donald Trump’s dark ideas don’t stand a chance against her aspirations for our country.

A future where women can make decisions about their own bodies.

name: Secure & Prosper
subject: “The Free Market is Dead”
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.secureandprosper._qCAQ)
---
| |
Dear fellow American, Time magazine published a story featuring the headline, "The Free Market is Dead: What Will Replace It?"

This is, of course, an exaggeration, but it makes clear the far-Left's goal--nothing less than a transformation of the world economy based on a rejection of economist Adam Smith's "invisible hand."

As the author writes, "We are on the cusp of a new era of broad-based prosperity in which our leaders are poised to more actively manage the American market."

Today's advocates of a "managed market" may call it by a new name--"The Great Reset"--but it is premised on an old and harmful idea.

What utopian ideologies like this one have in common is a misplaced faith in the rule of so-called experts and a corresponding disregard for the people's right to rule themselves. Taken to their logical conclusion, such ideologies can end only in **tyranny**.

The great British statesman Winston Churchill knew this, which led him to observe, "Nothing would be more fatal than for the government of states to get into the hands of the experts. Expert knowledge is limited knowledge: and the unlimited ignorance of the plain man who knows only what hurts is a safer guide, than any vigorous direction of a specialised character."

**In the fight to preserve our freedom, our greatest asset is education.** Americans who understand our country's founding principles and have a firm grasp of history are best prepared to resist the lure of utopian schemes.

**[That's why Hillsdale College has selected you to participate in our FREE MARKET SURVEY.](http://trk.secureandprosper._gwecYHDOhvtK_oiFg)**

Your answers will help us understand more clearly the views of mainstream Americans--not the so-called experts--concerning the importance of the free market system in our nation.

Please begin your survey below. Your answers will remain strictly confidential.

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/free-market-survey/](http://trk.secureandprosper.)**

Thank you for your time and attention--and for your support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 **_[Hillsdale College National Survey on the Free Market and Economic Liberty](http://trk.secureandprosper._tfEeDUqW9G61-7ukfbexg)_** **1\. Do you believe that the Constitution made it possible for America to become the freest and most prosperous nation in history?**

Hey everybody, [Bemidji Pride](https://votereedolson.us/l/mBBFVoMRxYcJ) is tomorrow at Rail River Folk School, and I hope I’ll see you there! Pride is a time for celebration, reflection, and solidarity. It's a moment to honor the progress made by the LGBTQIA2S+ community and to acknowledge the challenges they continue to face.
---
|
---
I believe that everyone deserves to be treated with dignity and respect, regardless of their sexual orientation or gender identity. Pride is about more than just parties and parades—though those are great, too. It's about recognizing the historical and ongoing struggles of the LGBTQIA2S+ community, and about working towards a more just and equitable future for all. Let's continue to challenge discrimination, promote equality, and celebrate the diversity that makes our world so vibrant. I hope to see you tomorrow at [Bemidji Pride](https://votereedolson.us/l/9RIwMYBaDSDt)! \- Reed Olson

| [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T95df2c96-edf8-4c7c-84f2-2b3684ddb028/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate. [And now, I am asking you to make a split donation to Blue Amp Action and my campaign — to defeat Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona and defend all the progress we have made together. Please, if you can afford it, chip in by using this link.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T506ec908-1fea-4fd5-909d-725083447553/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

| My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there. Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned. But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families. I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits. After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need. Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor. He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity. They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them. That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona. But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, FIRST. And today, I need your help. [Please, split $25 to my campaign and Blue Amp Action. Trump is rallying his supporters alongside Kari Lake, and we have to raise a ton of resources to defeat them and defend Arizona.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb34a3732-357c-404a-8591-b7de59997e5f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

We at Blue Amp Action are dedicated to liberal, open societies, where reason and science are applied to solve our problems; where civil rights--including voting rights!--are protected for all. We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. I am excited to announce that Hillsdale's online course, ["The American Left: From Liberalism to Despotism,"](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=a9a5933c30a14e1d827777333e034cc0&_e=0HLSiC4j6oZmdPfVknvwG_DKITugTUS5jv85m2VZ6ANgbZOOM_ZMBm5xNBYDwTKMrOg3DT8oI09g2Y1t9MVJbjKFNls-WPx2T0rvvIeiauVS7h_lnU_EAEHsy-zdhZyMJlMwPuQATPGPcyNApcBX_FO5r74AIDjb_e01yifK1_8ZiODTUVizkAIaJ3DYUI8IB-370PuY_JYmcKZnmgmqRW4yI3fdJricIsqPcqUTCKDgLJ5-wVCCjaVZ8fJHo46HNzJEr5LcD0ra607ZRrPF_RALwj30ofL7CiE7ns8yHF4QkL1K5fTsYYRfEb93ZZykRqjA253FgFyoolQVrmHVnzmOMFUyCHouTWZvi0hoAZ_TXzEZu5VGYBh7zgXWtfdrUQAF9fTAOx1xaQyvH58efD_9x8ueNIhOGrxdEwTEYwA%3D) is now available to own on DVD.

In this eleven-lecture course, Dr. Kevin Slack, associate professor of politics at Hillsdale College, examines the transformation in American politics since World War II.

He explains the origins of 1960s radicalism and its rejection of mid century liberalism; he reveals how these radicals came to dominate government and the universities beginning in the late 1970s; and he explores the rise of a neoliberal oligarchy in America and that oligarchy's alliance with the cultural Left in President Obama's second term.

This course seeks to reveal the key people, ideas, and aims of the modern Left and to provide solutions for defending the American way of life today.

Will you partner with us to promote this free online course and expand other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty? As a token of our appreciation for your support, we'll send you the DVD Box Set of the course for a gift of $100 or more.

**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hey folks,
Well, the DNC is over and it's time to GET TO WORK. There are 73 days left until Election Day and I encourage you to get involved! One of my favorite ways to get involved is by downloading the TPUSA Action app. You can text, call or send letters to constituents in key areas across the country and encourage them to vote. [Download it here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) and let's win this thing!

This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, August 23, 2024.
– Heidi Ganahl

|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[From state AGs to a House committee, conservatives want answers from SEC on ActBlue](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY GEOFF SAKALA, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)

[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In the first 48 hours following Kamala Harris’ launch of her Presidential campaign, she reportedly raised more than $100 million dollars, a record for any Presidential campaign in history.
This enormous online fundraising haul raised eyebrows in some conservative circles for its speed and scale for a vice president, previously with very low approval ratings.
And after that first burst of donations, the Harris campaign reported raising a total of $310 million in July, compared to only $138 million for former President Trump.
Shortly after reporting large fundraising figures in the first days and weeks of the Harris campaign, reports began surfacing on X, a social media news platform, that specific donors were found to have donated thousands of times totaling tens of thousands of dollars without their knowledge.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Polis grandstands at DNC on Project 2025 agenda from which Trump has repeatedly distanced](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [KDVR](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Governor Jared Polis spoke at the Democratic National Convention, criticizing the Republican agenda and praising Kamala Harris's vision for personal, internet, and economic freedoms.
* Vice Presidential nominee Tim Walz, known for his folksy, relatable persona, was set to accept his nomination amidst critiques from Republicans about his military record and personal narrative.
* Polis spotlighted the Project 2025 initiative from the Heritage Foundation, symbolically tearing a page from a prop book to emphasize his rejection of its conservative goals.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Analyzing a super-minority in Colorado’s legislature and what it means for governance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado's political landscape is seeing a shift toward Democratic dominance, with the House already placing Republicans in a super-minority and the Senate close to doing the same.
* A super-minority status, holding significantly fewer seats than the majority, leaves Republicans with limited power to influence legislation, particularly in opposing bills from the Democratic majority.
* In the Senate, Republicans are one seat away from also becoming a super-minority, which would further decrease their ability to challenge Democratic initiatives. The implications of a super-majority for Democrats include the ability to override vetoes, change legislative rules, and advance constitutional amendments without needing minority support.
* This shift could lead to legislation that predominantly reflects the Democratic agenda, with significant potential impacts on governance and policy in Colorado, emphasizing the importance of strategic voting to maintain a balanced political landscape.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Poll: Trump has gained since 2020 in Black, Hispanic demos but race is a dead heat](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The presidential race is extremely close after the Democratic National Convention, with Kamala Harris slightly leading Donald Trump by less than 1%, according to the latest Cook Political Report.
* Trump leads by 10% among men, while Harris leads by 10% among women. Trump is particularly strong among white, non-college-educated voters, whereas Harris performs well with white, college-educated voters.
* Trump's support among Black voters has doubled since 2020, now reaching 18.6%. Meanwhile, Harris sees a decline in Hispanic support compared to Biden's 2020 levels.
* Harris is favored by younger voters aged 18-29, but older voters aged 65 and above lean towards Trump. The highest voter turnout is among the older demographic.
* Both candidates have nearly equal crossover appeal from the opposing party's voters, with Harris slightly leading among independents by 0.1%.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[‘Weaker than reported’ U.S. economy created 818,000 fewer jobs than first accounting](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [FOX BUSINESS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The U.S. economy added 818,000 fewer jobs than previously reported during the year through March, leading to a significant revision of monthly job growth figures from 242,000 to 174,000 jobs per month.
* This marks the largest downward job revision since 2009 and reflects a weaker labor market than initially believed, prompting predictions of possible Federal Reserve rate cuts.
* Recent job reports, including a July increase in the unemployment rate to 4.3% and only 114,000 new jobs, have heightened concerns about a weakening labor market. The unemployment rate over the last three months triggered the Sahm rule, an economic indicator predicting a recession, which has historically been accurate since 1970.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[In epic online troll, Trump campaign creates policy website for Kamala Harris, citing her lack of one](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [NEW YORK POST](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Donald Trump's campaign created a mock website detailing Vice President Kamala Harris's policies, criticizing her for not having a policy page on her own campaign website.
* The fake site, [kamala2024policies.com](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), attributes controversial policies to Harris, such as ending cash bail, opening borders, and defunding police, to highlight her past political stances.
* The website lists specific actions attributed to Harris, including her support for the Minnesota Freedom Fund during the 2020 protests, which they claim helped free individuals who later committed crimes.
* The Trump campaign criticizes Harris for not conducting media interviews and changing her political positions, labeling her a "political chameleon."

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[House Democrat wants to block any further ballot measures on property tax, but it could blow up special session deal](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* A proposed constitutional amendment during Colorado's special session aims to prevent future statewide ballot measures that would limit property tax revenue, requiring local votes for such changes.
* Representative Mike Weissman supports the amendment for local control over taxation, but it faces opposition, particularly in the Senate, needing bipartisan support to pass. Critics argue the amendment could infringe on constitutional rights and disrupt uniform tax assessments across Colorado.
* The proposal risks derailing compromises on property tax reform, including deals made to avoid more drastic ballot measures. If successful, the amendment would solidify legislative control over property tax limits but must be settled by the September 6 deadline to avoid impacting agreed-upon tax reforms.

[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|

**[Emails from Readers: Say ‘Nuts’ to Polis and Dems, keep property tax on the ballot](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
**Editor’s note:** Want to express your opinion? Email Brian@RockyMountainVoice.com. Give us your succinct thoughts on current events, be sure to include your name and hometown, and we might feature your letter.
_Dear Mr. Editor,_
_I cannot believe the arrogance of the Democrat-led legislators and the posturing of Gov. Polis over the property tax issue._
_The Democrats seem to think that law-abiding, tax-paying, freedom-loving Colorado citizens are too stupid to really comprehend the importance of their socialist agenda. So much so, that when Prop. HH failed by a 59% to 41% margin, Senate Majority Leader Steve Fenberg stated in a TV news interview that Coloradans were swayed by extreme right-wing propaganda._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**

**[Sloan: The legacy of ‘free stuff’ Biden government will continue with Harris](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** BY KELLY SLOAN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Kamala Harris finally hinted at something resembling policy on Friday when she revealed snippets of her economic program, and it was every bit as horrifying as one would imagine._
_It was essentially a combination of spending sprees, price controls and offers of “free” stuff – meaning paid for by someone else. In other words, it was a prescription for more of the same, only writ large._
_Whether she wants it to or not – more pointedly, whether Democratic campaign advisors want it to be or not – Harris’ campaign offers largely a continuation of the Biden administration and its legacy. Which is what, exactly?_

clean_body: From state AGs to a House committee, conservatives want answers from SEC on ActBlue | | | | PRESENTED BY | | Hey folks, Well, the DNC is over and it's time to GET TO WORK. There are 73 days left until Election Day and I encourage you to get involved! One of my favorite ways to get involved is by downloading the TPUSA Action app. You can text, call or send letters to constituents in key areas across the country and encourage them to vote. and let's win this thing! This is the Mountain Minute for Friday, August 23, 2024. – Heidi Ganahl | | | TODAY'S TOP STORIES BY GEOFF SAKALA, In the first 48 hours following Kamala Harris’ launch of her Presidential campaign, she reportedly raised more than $100 million dollars, a record for any Presidential campaign in history. This enormous online fundraising haul raised eyebrows in some conservative circles for its speed and scale for a vice president, previously with very low approval ratings. And after that first burst of donations, the Harris campaign reported raising a total of $310 million in July, compared to only $138 million for former President Trump. Shortly after reporting large fundraising figures in the first days and weeks of the Harris campaign, reports began surfacing on X, a social media news platform, that specific donors were found to have donated thousands of times totaling tens of thousands of dollars without their knowledge. | Colorado Governor Jared Polis spoke at the Democratic National Convention, criticizing the Republican agenda and praising Kamala Harris's vision for personal, internet, and economic freedoms. Vice Presidential nominee Tim Walz, known for his folksy, relatable persona, was set to accept his nomination amidst critiques from Republicans about his military record and personal narrative. Polis spotlighted the Project 2025 initiative from the Heritage Foundation, symbolically tearing a page from a prop book to emphasize his rejection of its conservative goals. | Colorado's political landscape is seeing a shift toward Democratic dominance, with the House already placing Republicans in a super-minority and the Senate close to doing the same. A super-minority status, holding significantly fewer seats than the majority, leaves Republicans with limited power to influence legislation, particularly in opposing bills from the Democratic majority. In the Senate, Republicans are one seat away from also becoming a super-minority, which would further decrease their ability to challenge Democratic initiatives. The implications of a super-majority for Democrats include the ability to override vetoes, change legislative rules, and advance constitutional amendments without needing minority support. This shift could lead to legislation that predominantly reflects the Democratic agenda, with significant potential impacts on governance and policy in Colorado, emphasizing the importance of strategic voting to maintain a balanced political landscape. | The presidential race is extremely close after the Democratic National Convention, with Kamala Harris slightly leading Donald Trump by less than 1%, according to the latest Cook Political Report. Trump leads by 10% among men, while Harris leads by 10% among women. Trump is particularly strong among white, non-college-educated voters, whereas Harris performs well with white, college-educated voters. Trump's support among Black voters has doubled since 2020, now reaching 18.6%. Meanwhile, Harris sees a decline in Hispanic support compared to Biden's 2020 levels. Harris is favored by younger voters aged 18-29, but older voters aged 65 and above lean towards Trump. The highest voter turnout is among the older demographic. Both candidates have nearly equal crossover appeal from the opposing party's voters, with Harris slightly leading among independents by 0.1%. | The U.S. economy added 818,000 fewer jobs than previously reported during the year through March, leading to a significant revision of monthly job growth figures from 242,000 to 174,000 jobs per month. This marks the largest downward job revision since 2009 and reflects a weaker labor market than initially believed, prompting predictions of possible Federal Reserve rate cuts. Recent job reports, including a July increase in the unemployment rate to 4.3% and only 114,000 new jobs, have heightened concerns about a weakening labor market. The unemployment rate over the last three months triggered the Sahm rule, an economic indicator predicting a recession, which has historically been accurate since 1970. | Donald Trump's campaign created a mock website detailing Vice President Kamala Harris's policies, criticizing her for not having a policy page on her own campaign website. The fake site, , attributes controversial policies to Harris, such as ending cash bail, opening borders, and defunding police, to highlight her past political stances. The website lists specific actions attributed to Harris, including her support for the Minnesota Freedom Fund during the 2020 protests, which they claim helped free individuals who later committed crimes. The Trump campaign criticizes Harris for not conducting media interviews and changing her political positions, labeling her a "political chameleon." | A proposed constitutional amendment during Colorado's special session aims to prevent future statewide ballot measures that would limit property tax revenue, requiring local votes for such changes. Representative Mike Weissman supports the amendment for local control over taxation, but it faces opposition, particularly in the Senate, needing bipartisan support to pass. Critics argue the amendment could infringe on constitutional rights and disrupt uniform tax assessments across Colorado. The proposal risks derailing compromises on property tax reform, including deals made to avoid more drastic ballot measures. If successful, the amendment would solidify legislative control over property tax limits but must be settled by the September 6 deadline to avoid impacting agreed-upon tax reforms. | Editor’s note: Want to express your opinion? body:
With our August fundraising deadline quickly approaching, we may soon have to make some difficult decisions.
#
Friend,
We’ve been working hard this year to support changemaking candidates in crucial races around the country and help them win big this November.
And we’ve been able to boost some incredible progressive campaigns thanks to the folks on this grassroots team who chip in to fund our efforts.
But with our August fundraising deadline quickly approaching, we may soon have to make some difficult decisions.
That’s because right now, we’re currently on track to fall short of our monthly fundraising goals. And if we don’t turn things around, we’ll have to reevaluate our budget and decide what races we want to prioritize with both our time and money.
We don’t want to have to do that. We want to be able to support every candidate that we believe in. The candidates who are fighting for our democracy, for action on climate change, for an economy that works for all of us. The candidates who will drive turnout for the Harris-Walz ticket.
But being able to support ALL of our candidates requires the help of everyone reading this who believes in our mission.

---

The new Cold War is at hand.

While in the 20th century, America had to face off against the Soviet Union, today the Chinese Communist Party is America's greatest international threat.

America needs a comprehensive plan to win this new Cold War. Which is why we at The Heritage Foundation created this FREE eBook titled _5 Things America Must Do to Win the New Cold War._

# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=3952%2E552475%2EeGGeJn)
Peter,
Last night, I spoke at the Democratic National Convention to share the stakes of this election.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240823-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240823-1&refcode2=3952_552475_eGGeJn&akid=3952%2E552475%2EeGGeJn)

**Here’s the simple truth: Pennsylvania is the battleground that will decide this election** — and with the Democratic ticket official, it’s time to hit the ground running.
Our fundamental rights are on the ballot this November. If we want to protect our basic freedoms like women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights, we must keep our Commonwealth blue.
My opponent is a Wall Street multi-millionaire who’s only out for his bottom line, even if it hurts working families, and he’s made it clear that he would be a “yes” vote for Donald Trump’s extreme agenda. He doesn’t understand what Pennsylvanians are going through or what they need.
I believe you need to know people to represent them. I was born and raised in Scranton, Pennsylvania. I raised my family there, and I still live there today.
Here in Pennsylvania, we strive to be a Commonwealth in life as well as in name. I know the challenges we face, fight for our values, and will always stand up for working people over big corporations and special interests.
We cannot keep our Senate majority or the White House without winning in Pennsylvania, which is why your support is so critical.
**[With so much at stake, please chip in whatever you can to our campaign today. Your support will make a real difference this November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20240823-1?recurring=1&refcode=em20240823-1&refcode2=3952_552475_eGGeJn&akid=3952%2E552475%2EeGGeJn)**

This is probably the hardest email I’ve ever written.

| |
---
| | | | | | | Friend --
I wish things would have gone a different way...
| **_Democrat Vicente Gonzalez holds back Republican surge, returns 34th Congressional District to Democratic control._**
---

This is probably the hardest email I've ever written.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. **

[](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zo258fm9v51ueri823j48g03qaas1ot76un27rd0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5gm8ob2cdh2bs)

---
Everyone expected me to just walk away - _but I 'm not someone who ever, ever gives up._

I'm taking a leap of faith here and have thrown my name on the ballot once again.

The Democrats overpowered us in this race before - _and now all indicators are pointing toward this election being a complete toss-up._

My stomach is in knots - **the Democrats have already raised an astonishing $30 MILLION, and Kamala just raised $80 million bucks**(I know, I can't believe anyone would give her money either...but they do).

**That 's why I'm humbly asking for your help: _[Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z5rgv608mnhofto7869muvmksohl2drh28gjmtl8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5gm8ob2cdh2bs "Will you step up and chip in just a few bucks in the next hour to help us counter this massive Left-wing onslaught?")_**

I'll just tell you: I'm afraid to see what happens if this email doesn't work.

**The Democrats & the media hacks are terrified of me - that's because as a young Hispanic female, I obliterate every woke narrative they push. So, they will truly do anything to destroy me.**

The Democrats know that if they lose the Hispanic vote, it's over for them. _Forever._

I'm opening my heart to you here: Please, please help out:
| | | [**CONTRIBUTE**](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zsdgalrvjoh08qls4vde64aepp4h57mchhals3j8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj1c5gm8ob2cdh2bs)

God bless you, and God bless America.

**Mayra Flores**
America First Candidate
Texas Congressional District 34

clean_body: = Peter, It’s official! VP Kamala Harris has accepted the Democratic nomination for President of the United States. Now that our ticket is set, it’s time to get to work. VP Harris and Governor Walz are the leaders we need in the White House. But when they win, they’ll need a strong Congress standing with them in the Capitol, too. Right now, Mississippi is represented by a Trump-endorsed Senator who has supported archaic anti-choice laws and failed to deliver economic relief to our state. But it doesn’t have to be this way. Ty has fought for Mississippians his entire life. We have an opportunity to elect him to the U.S. Senate to fight for us and support VP Harris’ work to move our country forward. So, let’s get to work. = = The countdown to Election Day is on. With your help, we’re making every day count. Thank you for standing with us! – Team Pinkins * | The son of a tractor driver, Ty doesn’t come from a wealthy family. He was born and raised in the small town of Rolling Fork, and is a proud son of the Mississippi Delta. Frustrated by the lack of action from lawmakers on the issues facing people in Mississippi–and believing that the hard-working voters of Mississippi deserve much better–Ty Pinkins decided to run for office: the United States Senate in 2024. = = Use of military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform do not imply endorsement by the Department of the Navy or the Department of Defense. | | Dear friend, I invite you to view our eight-lecture course "**[American Citizenship and Its Decline](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97e8d166dfef4a3da085e8684cbd8960&_e=qhDYK_mgQGUv35H1ECNLHd7rFr-3UWRe_Cy6ko_7ZNV9MmlwUg22V5XrgI86c7cOJrRRod155GTgJMtHwrfjXGIBVropXCs9IRItkG_pLzA4UxE57FEXEKiOxpBmo54ydAFqRLnUSPmm5uMCouKmrGbuY6rl0nSunCiE4Q01T3ViCuJVsiZzjm0MZookG_DrBUiqHIUqKWXPikD9pPLBC0MleYvyASZ6DRdGMTAlUOSdX61dMoXLpir8A1XK5v-98kv90CL8Vprz1miO_mhnGaAymLeoAhqSW79nxAZPMK9v053uxDWlxl2f2FRVodyQZ26MwhfWXluQHcdmHFiPhIbmjoHW2I1m_vUFcWBaKZkkZa1v8YwhYijoXM_feEPo1YzB4gCbnVio4-M5WasZcA%3D%3D)** ," based on Victor Davis Hanson's book, _The Dying Citizen_.

Like the book, the course describes the current crises in America as symptoms of a far larger problem: the steady decline of the autonomy and political influence of the citizen.

The class describes the origins and history of citizenship in the West, reminding us that it is a rare phenomenon both in the past and the present--given the enormous responsibility placed on citizens to create and control their own government.
---
| [](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97e8d166dfef4a3da085e8684cbd8960&_e=qhDYK_mgQGUv35H1ECNLHd7rFr-3UWRe_Cy6ko_7ZNV9MmlwUg22V5XrgI86c7cOJrRRod155GTgJMtHwrfjXGIBVropXCs9IRItkG_pLzA4UxE57FEXEKiOxpBmo54ydAFqRLnUSPmm5uMCouKmrGbuY6rl0nSunCiE4Q01T3ViCuJVsiZzjm0MZookG_DrBUiqHIUqKWXPikD9pPLBC0MleYvyASZ6DRdGMTAlUOSH7w3drpN5jdQf4rXOOPwgJ_kSQkUpGCualIT5ykwOc8lLpkLJgMSznNg1iLGGxx2OisnJdPJamCLrOreuI4E_ZuqBfeAskUULabyXJithFFnkxUWDyxz4_6bwaIsn8dQDdRk9w5waJGniOLbtxmffI-9kQZ1CsX3rWoy-oPR9ww%3D%3D)
---
| | Citizenship then requires a large and self-reliant middle class--currently shrinking under enormous economic strains. Clearly defined and enforced borders are also essential to ensure a civic space in which citizens can nurture common customs, sustain traditions, and honor their own shared past.

Yet borders are now increasingly fluid as mere residence and citizenship seem often indistinguishable. Pre-civilizational tribalism--identifying by superficial appearance rather than through shared culture and values--is returning to America.

These organic, bottom-up challenges are often matched by top-down stresses such as the growth of a huge, permanent, but unelected, government of bureaucrats and administrators who combine judicial, executive, and legislative powers that overwhelm the citizen.

In addition, revisionists in law, the media, and politics seek to change the Constitution, long-held customs of governance, and political traditions for short-term partisan agendas, on the theory that a new, changing, and fluid Constitution must match an always evolving human nature.

Globalism is an ancient challenge to the sovereignty of the nation-state. But in the age of instant communications and unprecedented concentrations of globalized wealth, so often elites seek to supplant American laws and independence with international organizations and often without the consent of the legislative branch or the assent of the governed.

The course ends, however, on an optimistic note that citizens still have it within their power to restore our traditions of empowered citizenship and reassert control over the government.

You can receive a DVD box set of "**American Citizenship and Its Decline** " with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more toward Hillsdale College's Annual Fund. You can easily give and reserve your DVD box set using this secure link:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/citizenship-dvd](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=97e8d166dfef4a3da085e8684cbd8960&_e=qhDYK_mgQGUv35H1ECNLHd7rFr-3UWRe_Cy6ko_7ZNV9MmlwUg22V5XrgI86c7cOJrRRod155GTgJMtHwrfjXGIBVropXCs9IRItkG_pLzA4UxE57FEXEKiOxpBmo54ydAFqRLnUSPmm5uMCouKmrGbuY6rl0nSunCiE4Q01T3ViCuJVsiZzjm0MZookG_DrBUiqHIUqKWXPikD9pPLBC0MleYvyASZ6DRdGMTAlUOQxjFdatBJUW3MwziqNXmc_xnK2CuwCKMSJwUSDeiVED3ey2l3x7RnkjLOu530JdXC4jiueqrajHn3gj0N9f9IC7M8q5k7-Drhm11glSUlRO_hdV1YLgeM_MUz5bOgxchO6ZNWFlJSjk9ySkarvNmQhSTXZAd8p7bSvG2lDcP5p3w%3D%3D)

Best wishes,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.
Executive Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

The energy on the ground for our campaign has been electric.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/a23733f1-4e1b-4a66-8f9e-8d07bf5a507d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
We've held big events with hundreds of voters at a time across rural, urban, and suburban Missouri -- in areas like Palmyra, St. Joe, Columbia, St. Louis, and Dexter.
We've raised over $4 million since July 1st, with an average contribution of $33 and donations from every single one of Missouri's 114 counties and the City of St. Louis. We've built a record-breaking grassroots coalition to defeat Josh Hawley and take back this U.S. Senate seat.
On top of all that, we've aired TV ads introducing my background to voters and holding Josh Hawley accountable for his record -- on reproductive rights, on the border, and on his refusal to make real investments into Missouri.
We've got the momentum it will take to win this race.
So here's my promise to you over the next 74 days:
In gutted towns and forgotten neighborhoods in every corner of this state, on TV and online and everywhere else -- I'll continue fighting hard to take this Senate seat back for real Missourians.
I hope you'll join me by pitching in whatever amount you can today to help defeat Josh Hawley.

subject: Don't stop thinking about tomorrow!

body:
https://www.everyaction.com/ [https://www.everyaction.com/]
Friend,
The energy at the 2024 Democratic National Convention in Chicago is ecstatic. From the passionate speeches to the sense of unity in the air, it’s clear that progressive Democrats across the country are ready to work for our future.
This convention is a powerful reminder that–even in challenging times–our belief in a better tomorrow will carry us forward. As the song they played last night goes, “Don’t stop thinking about tomorrow!”
But the work doesn’t stop there; It’s just beginning. Despite the good vibes at the convention, we know this election will be a majorly uphill battle down the ballot.
At the DNC we’ve seen vibrant energy and smart policies for: affordable housing, better healthcare, lowered taxes and cost of living for working families and seniors, and improved K-12 and CTE education opportunities. We also know we have a chance to restore abortion rights at a national level.
As we transform the excitement and hope from the DNC into our campaign here in rural Oregon, we must remember that our fight is how we make those plans come to life in a way that fits us. We can get these policies enacted if we win this election.
Your support is essential to keep that momentum going for the voters that need to hear it. Together, we can bring the vitality from Chicago to our small towns and rural communities in Oregon’s 2nd Congressional District. If you want to bring that passion on display at the DNC home, will you donate to our campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dan-ruby--friends-of-1?refcode=dnc]
Sincerely,
Dan Ruby

body:
I don’t know about you, but I am FIRED UP from the past four days of the Democratic National Convention.

[|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/6YkELp59C66pn-g7LulubA~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoqz6uP0QgaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuZXJpY2ZvcmlsbGlub2lzLmNvbS9XA3NwY0IKZrvCuchmjOkHblIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAABs~)
| | Peter, I don’t know about you, but I am FIRED UP from the past four days of the Democratic National Convention. **Democrats are unified, passionate, and ready to win up and down the ballot on November 5.** [](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/QQEC6icZuQu3TBTk6X4DPw~~/AAUS1gA~/RgRoqz6uP0TkaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2VzLXEzLTIwMjQ_) Our friends on the other side of the state in Chicago proved to be gracious hosts, and from the first time the DJ played until the final words from Vice President Harris, there was an unmistakable sense of hope – for November, and for the next eight years. Democrats are unified, passionate, and ready to win up and down the ballot on November 5. Our friends on the other side of the state in Chicago proved to be gracious hosts, and from the first time the DJ played until the final words from Vice President Harris, there was an unmistakable sense of hope – for November, and for the next eight years. clean_body: And I will not shut up | Peter, I’m Riley Gaines. Maybe you’ve heard me talk about how other female swimmers and I were forced to compete against men -- and even share locker rooms with them. Most people sat idly by and allowed this injustice to happen. That’s when I realized that nobody else was going to stand up for me, my teammates, and other women like us. I had to speak out. That’s why I launched the Riley Gaines Center at the Leadership Institute. My team of Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are building a movement of students, athletes, and concerned citizens who are fed up with the attack on our freedoms and rights. I’d love to have you join us to defy the dangerous gender ideology that’s spreading rampant throughout society today. Women already fought for equality. Now, our achievements are being erased by men who declare themselves women. Government is making matters worse. Look how the Biden Administration is altering Title IX rules, for instance. Title IX used to protect against discrimination on the basis of sex -- on the incontrovertible, biological fact that men are men and women are women and both are afforded equal access under the law to government-funded programs. But now, the Biden administration’s proposed Title IX changes will stop schools from enforcing women-only recognitions and spaces. They’ll rob women of opportunities, put them in physical danger, and silence them when they dare to dissent. %%first%%, I’ve gotten used to the left trying to shut me up. But now they’re trying to erase all women. I’m not backing down from this fight. I hope you won’t either. On behalf of America’s daughters, At this urgent moment, my Riley Gaines Center Ambassadors and I are working to protect the rights of women and girls against the Biden administration’s Title IX changes. We’re taking on the gender ideology radicals who aim to erase women’s place in this country. Patriotic Americans like you who care about women’s rights -- and the truth -- are rising up to stand with us. Together, you and I can stop the left’s attacks, and save women’s place in America’s future. | Hi Friend,
It’s such an honor to be on the campaign trail and meeting so many amazing Texans!
Like those in Burleson County!

### Recently I attended a dinner with the Burleson County Democrats - and got featured in the Burleson County Tribune _(old school newspaper style - my favorite!)_
---
[](https://theresa4texas.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be937c1781d002a370f5841dc&id=aa65659b01&e=ebba716312)
|
### I shared my commitments with these wonderful people:

### 📚Public schools are the future of America.

There needs to be incentives for more teachers in every school.
Education should be tailored to each child so that our children’s futures will be filled with opportunity.

### ❤️🩹 Healthcare should be accessible.

I believe we should expand access through rural clinics and give incentives to keep doctors in Texas.
I’ll work towards cutting the red tape to make health care simpler and cheaper for everyone.

### 🚺 To be pro-choice is to provide a choice.

And that choice should be made by individuals, not politicians.

### 🌨️ There are better solutions for extreme weather.

Such as local and reliable energy generation.

### 🔫 There has to be sensible gun reform.

I’ll work hard for red-flag laws, raising the age to buy firearms and implementing other safety measures in our schools while continuing to increase awareness and mental health support.

### Meeting Texans like you face-to-face is such an important way to show how we can work TOGETHER to bring a brighter future to Texas.

But gas, miles on my car, advertising and more costs money, so I can’t keep up the momentum without your support!

| | | I endured the gauntlet of West Point Military Academy, then boot camp, then became a Tank Platoon Leader in the final days of the Cold War.

I briefed President Trump on America's most classified matters of national security while Director of CIA.

And I stood eye-to-eye with the most dangerous dictators in the world as Trump's Secretary of State.

**It takes a lot to make me feel on edge. So the fact that I 'm even sending you this email should give you pause. **

Because I'm afraid we have a problem. A big one.

I just got word that Kamala Harris and the Democrats are _closer than they 've ever been before_ to destroying our Conservative House Majority once and for all. The latest reports show they've stockpiled over $100,000,000 to defeat us in enough swing states to bring forth a COMPLETE LIBERAL TAKEOVER.

The ONLY THING standing in the way of Kamala Harris having full control - and ramming through any radical policy she wants - is just a few competitive House seats. That's it.

I don't tell you this lightly and I know that's not what you want to see happen to our country.

If all you can spare is ten or twenty bucks, that would be incredible. If you can afford more that's even better. I only ask that everyone give something.

Last night, after four days of powerful speeches from the best and brightest members of the Democratic Party, Kamala Harris took the stage at the Democratic National Convention and accepted her nomination as the Democratic candidate for president of the United States.

What we saw last night from Vice President Harris was nothing short of remarkable: she projected strength, grace, sharp policy acumen, a fierce love for our country, and an unwavering determination to make it better. [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91384132/493669373/-1706349631?refcode=WTEFEST66_20240823_HarrisSpeech_PL_v1s4&sourceid=1054720&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDRjZDI2MC03MTYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=me1MpC0JnEAP_zkzmuGuBx7qHACEYLMAV1rmktG_2Po=) | [HELP HARRIS WIN](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91384133/493669374/-1706349631?refcode=WTEFEST66_20240823_HarrisSpeech_PL_v1s4&sourceid=1054720&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDRjZDI2MC03MTYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=me1MpC0JnEAP_zkzmuGuBx7qHACEYLMAV1rmktG_2Po=)

As we watched Vice President Harris speak boldly on the economy, reproductive freedom, gun violence, voting rights, and global security, we — and millions of Americans across the country — thought: _This is what a president looks like._

**"We trust women," **she declared. "When Congress passes a bill to restore reproductive freedom, as president of the United States, I will proudly sign it into law."
[HELP ELECT A DEMOCRATIC-MAJORITY CONGRESS](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91384134/493669375/-1706349631?refcode=WTEFEST66_20240823_HarrisSpeech_PL_v1s4&sourceid=1054720&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDRjZDI2MC03MTYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=me1MpC0JnEAP_zkzmuGuBx7qHACEYLMAV1rmktG_2Po=)

In fact, Harris delivered a stunning rebuke of the former president and his dangerous anti-choice agenda: "Donald Trump is an unserious man," she warned. **"But the consequences of putting Donald Trump back in the White House are extremely serious."**
[HELP DEFEAT DONALD TRUMP](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91384135/493669376/-1706349631?refcode=WTEFEST66_20240823_HarrisSpeech_PL_v1s4&sourceid=1054720&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9UU00vVFNNRUwvMS84NzA2OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxMDRjZDI2MC03MTYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=me1MpC0JnEAP_zkzmuGuBx7qHACEYLMAV1rmktG_2Po=)

Kamala Harris is the best candidate to lead our party and our country forward. She's ready to take on the anti-choice, anti-democracy extremists of the Republican Party — and she's got what it takes to win.
**Peter, we are determined to elect Kamala Harris as the next president of the United States, and we will do everything in our power to deliver a Democratic-majorty House and Senate to help enact her pro-choice, pro-freedom agenda. clean_body: Last night, Kamala Harris took the stage at the Democratic National Convention. | = Peter, Last night, after four days of powerful speeches from the best and brightest members of the Democratic Party, Kamala Harris took the stage at the Democratic National Convention and accepted her nomination as the Democratic candidate for president of the United States. What we saw last night from Vice President Harris was nothing short of remarkable: she projected strength, grace, sharp policy acumen, a fierce love for our country, and an unwavering determination to make it better. = | = As we watched Vice President Harris speak boldly on the economy, reproductive freedom, gun violence, voting rights, and global security, we — and millions of Americans across the country — thought: This is what a president looks like. "We trust women," she declared. "When Congress passes a bill to restore reproductive freedom, as president of the United States, I will proudly sign it into law." = And she was crystal-clear about exactly why reproductive rights need defending at this moment: because Donald Trump handpicked a U.S. Supreme Court that he knew would decimate the national right to abortion. In fact, Harris delivered a stunning rebuke of the former president and his dangerous anti-choice agenda: "Donald Trump is an unserious man," she warned. "But the consequences of putting Donald Trump back in the White House are extremely serious." = Kamala Harris is the best candidate to lead our party and our country forward. She's ready to take on the anti-choice, anti-democracy extremists of the Republican Party — and she's got what it takes to win. Peter, we are determined to elect Kamala Harris as the next president of the United States, and we will do everything in our power to deliver a Democratic-majorty House and Senate to help enact her pro-choice, pro-freedom agenda. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis, the
Uncommitted Movement had a modest request at the DNC: a speaking slot for
one Palestinian-American. The DNC said No.

The Democratic Party made space on the DNC stage for Republicans, the CEO
of American Express, and sheriffs cheering increases in police funding.
The Party could have, and should have, made space for
Palestinian-Americans.

The DNC made a choice to exclude Palestinian voices from the Convention
stage, but we cannot stay silent when the U.S. government is funding and
arming Netanyahu’s military.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19268?source=email-20240823&t=1011&akid=6638%2E5885482%2ExKa107 ]Add your name: End U.S. support for Netanyahu’s relentless bombing of
Gaza. It is a moral necessity to change American policy immediately!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19268?source=email-20240823&t=1012&akid=6638%2E5885482%2ExKa107 ]ADD YOUR NAME

This is not hard to solve. If our leaders in Congress and the White House
wanted to end the war on Gaza, they would. As Ilhan said outside the
Convention, “If you really wanted a Ceasefire, you just stop sending the
weapons.”

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19268?source=email-20240823&t=1013&akid=6638%2E5885482%2ExKa107 ][IMG]

But the U.S. government has refused to stop sending weapons to Netanyahu.
In fact, the Biden administration just signed a $20 billion weapons deal
with Israel. How can this go on?

The UAW, Chair of the Michigan Democratic Party, and pro-Peace
progressives like Ilhan Omar, Rashida Tlaib, and many others joined the
demand for a Palestinian speaker — for space on the DNC stage to call for
Peace. It was still denied.

The proposed speaker from the pro-Peace movement, Georgia State Rep. and
Palestinian-American Ruwa Romman, was ready to urge Democrats to broker a
Ceasefire and end the killing of Palestinians. Her speech included support
of Kamala Harris. It included calls to defeat Trump, who she said, “uses
my identity as a Palestinian as a slur.”

Most Democrats support a Ceasefire and an end to U.S. support for the
murder of 40,000 civilians in Gaza. The Biden administration and Congress
must act to save Palestinian lives.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/19268?source=email-20240823&t=1014&akid=6638%2E5885482%2ExKa107 ]Add your name: Stop sending bombs to Netanyahu and the Israeli
military! It is unconscionable to continue American support for the
atrocities against the Palestinian people.

When we organize, we win.

My unit was the hardest- hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.

Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.

But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families.

I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.

After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.

Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.

He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.

They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.

That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.

But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter.

And today, I need your help.

clean_body: | Peter, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate. = | = My unit was the hardest- hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there. Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned. But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families. I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits. After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need. Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor. He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity. They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them. That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona. But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter. I’m taking a trip down memory lane today, Peter. It’s the summer of 1984. I was 22 years old, fresh out of college, and back in my small, unfurnished apartment in Madison, Wisconsin. I had a mat on the floor, a pan my aunt had given me, and a tiny, black-and-white television set. I remember sitting there alone, watching the Democratic National Convention. I was very interested in politics, but... I didn’t really know what my options were. That 1984 convention was the one where the Democrats nominated Geraldine Ferraro, the first woman to run for Vice President. So, there I was, in my little apartment, watching her take the stage and give her acceptance speech, thinking, _‘Wow, I can do anything in politics. The barriers are being broken. name: Nancy Dahlstrom
subject: An important announcement
body:
See my statement:| | | Dear, Peter. I appreciate your support over the last 9 months for my campaign to bring a conservative voice back to Congress. I've said it throughout this race and I'll say it once more: I've always done what's right for Alaska. And today is no different. At this time, the best thing I can do for our state and our Party is to withdraw my name from the general election ballot and end my campaign. Thank you to you and the people of our incredible state for believing in me and fighting with me. I’m so grateful to be an Alaskan and thankful to Alaska herself for all that she has given me, my family, and our country. Warm Regards,
---
---
**Nancy Dahlstrom**
_Your friend and Alaska's Lieutenant Governor_

**Republicans have the BEST map they’ve had in a decade in the Senate. There are 7 opportunities for us to FLIP Democrat held seats.**

In a moment I am going to ask you to join me in sending your personal endorsement to Eric Hovde but let me tell you why Eric Hovde and Wisconsin should be on your radar in the final months of this cycle.

Eric Hovde is a born entrepreneur. Unlike his far-Left opponent, Tammy Baldwin, who has spent over three decades in Washington, he’s built a business.

But that’s not all – Eric has also dedicated his time to help troubled community banks. He’s helped vulnerable children by providing shelter and care in Wisconsin and around the world.

He represents the type of compassion that Callista and I have worked hard to promote through faith and hard work. I know he’d make an amazing United States Senator – but right now, he’s been outraised and outspent by Senate Democrats and liberal dark money Super PACs determined to send Tammy Baldwin back for a third term.

When I think about everything we’re up against in the climate fight — from the relentless grip the fossil fuel industry has on our political system to rapidly escalating climate disasters and the GOP’s dystopian Project 2025 agenda — it’s easy to feel overwhelmed. But there’s something that always keeps me moving forward. **It’s hope.**(I think a lot of us were feeling a bit more of _that_ feeling this week, right?) _I always say: Hope is like a muscle._ The more we use it, the stronger it gets. But it doesn’t grow on its own. We have to keep working at it, especially when the challenges seem insurmountable. The thing about hope is that it’s not passive. It’s not sitting around, waiting for something good to happen. No, hope is active. Hope is getting up every day, even when the odds are stacked against us, and saying, “I’m not giving up.” Hope is voting in every election, even when not every election goes our way. It’s showing up at protests, town halls, and community meetings, even when it feels like no one is listening. It’s continuing to organize, educate, and advocate for bold climate policies, even when progress is slow. **Every time you knock on a door, make a phone call, or cast your ballot, you’re building that muscle.** Folks, the fossil fuel industry is betting on our despair. They’re hoping we’ll get tired, that we’ll give up. But they're underestimating us. I can’t afford to let despair win when my grandchildren’s futures are on the line. We’re not just fighting for ourselves — we’re fighting for the world our kids and grandkids will inherit. When I leave this place, I want my grandkids to know that I did everything in my power to create a livable future for them. **I have no choice but to choose hope.** And our hope isn’t in vain; it’s fueled by the victories we’ve already achieved together and the belief that we can achieve even more. Your support through JanePAC alone has made a real difference. Together, we’ve helped **force Big Oil to drop a dangerous referendum in California.** We’ve also**endorsed more than 65 candidates** across the nation this year, from the House to local offices, who are committed to environmental justice. In key races around the country, we’re paving the way for a shift in power, like in Arizona, where **all 11 of our endorsed candidates won their state legislature primaries.** Watching Kamala Harris accept the Democratic nomination this week filled me with hope. The energy from young people and climate voters around her candidacy is palpable. But to truly seize this moment, we need to stay engaged and keep pushing forward. So today, I’m asking you to join me in building that muscle. [**Let’s keep this movement strong by supporting the leaders who are fighting for our future. If you’re ready to help me keep hope alive in the climate fight, chip in any amount to fuel our mission and elect climate champions in November and beyond.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91388540/493683086/2105508926?refcode=ea.29c0d0c4-7761-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.29c0d0c4-7761-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5YzBkMGM0LTc3NjEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FNDkvN2aY4ThCalkW5U39_jB3xEGK_clJUcpfq3_8tE=) | [**DONATE TODAY**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91388541/493683087/2105508926?refcode=ea.29c0d0c4-7761-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&ms=ea.29c0d0c4-7761-ef11-991a-6045bddbfc4b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjI5YzBkMGM0LTc3NjEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=FNDkvN2aY4ThCalkW5U39_jB3xEGK_clJUcpfq3_8tE=)
