# Erin Farris-Olsen for Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court 2024,

The Clerk of the Supreme Court isn’t a flashy, well-known job. Yet the person sitting in that office can do so much important work to uplift and help people navigating our judicial system. They can also do untold harm, as does my opponent with his extreme political and personal agenda.
---
[](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=9ffd51269b&e=5e62e9066d)
| [**Please help me put my significant experience as an attorney, a public servant, and an advocate for access to justice for ALL Montanans to work as your next Clerk of the Montana Supreme Court.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=98a693a2b1&e=5e62e9066d) I’m committed to being impartial, non-partisan and working in the best interests of all Montanans regardless of their personal or political beliefs. As the only attorney in this race, I have the professional expertise and experience to get the job done correctly, fairly and in a manner that Montanans deserve.
---
[SUPPORT TODAY!](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=86c63ca9dc&e=5e62e9066d)
| Together, we can win this race. All I need is your support. Let’s make our courts, and our justice system, better for all of us.
Regards,
**Erin**

[**PS: Your personal donation of $100, $50, $25 - but no more than the $790 legal limit - will help fuel my successful grassroots campaign.**](https://erinformontana.us17.list-manage.com/track/click?u=846aeb55e2fc599e968ca8fae&id=df54952875&e=5e62e9066d)**** Please join our movement and encourage friends, family and professional colleagues to do the same.

You don't have to be an elections expert or a lawyer to understand that opponents of voting rights use tricks like extra dates on envelopes or multiple signature requirements to confuse voters, challenge ballots, and suppress the vote.
This is all just part of their dangerous ploys to protect their own power, Team. RUSH $25 or more today to end their tricks and defend our right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082324_2&amount=25]

WHYY: Outcome of Pa. mail voting case may impact 2024 election [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082324_2&amount=25]
A little history, Team: During the 2022 midterms, more than one million Pennsylvania voters dropped their ballots in the mail, well in time for them to be counted by Election Day. But several thousand of them were rejected without notice, due to errors with how they dated the hand-written field on the envelope in addition to the date they wrote on the ballot itself.
Yes, to answer the obvious question: PA makes you date the ballot twice . Why? So that people make simple mistakes and give partisans an excuse to toss their ballot. From a news article on the case:
" Pennsylvania voting law requires residents who vote-by-mail to hand write the date they filled out and dropped their ballot in the mailbox on the outside of the envelope. The issue has become a federal case with Republicans and voter advocates asking the U.S. Third Circuit Court of Appeals to decide whether Pennsylvania voters must write accurate mailing dates for their ballots to be accepted - even when the ballot arrives by deadline. "
Opponents of voting rights are trying to get ballots tossed for envelopes with missing or illegible dates on the outside, regardless of how correct things are inside on the ballot itself.
Why is this important? Well, in 2022, one candidate for U.S. Senate received more than 700,000 mailed-in votes than his opponent. That candidate won by less than 300,000 votes, a 5% margin. Several thousand ballots being tossed in a close election this fall could easily swing Pennsylvania's 19 Electoral College votes from one side to the other.
The danger is clear, Team. Help defend mail-in ballots with $25 or whatever you can right now and make every vote count >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=082324_2&amount=25]

Peter,
Yesterday, former President Trump pretended he cares about securing the border. He doesn’t. And neither does his loyal foot soldier, Juan Ciscomani.
The Bipartisan Border Security bill was the most significant border security reform in decades. It had the backing of both Republicans and Democrats. And it was endorsed by the Border Patrol union.
But then, the deal was sabotaged by former President Trump with help from Juan Ciscomani, my opponent.
Trump feared the bill's success would undermine his ability to use the border as a political tool in his campaign, and Ciscomani and others like him were too willing to obey by rejecting the deal out of hand.
This is a clear example of Trump and Ciscomani putting politics over people, even when the communities along our border are in dire need of solutions. It's outrageous that meaningful legislation was killed for political gain, and it shows what we've suspected all along — some politicians don’t really want to solve this problem. Instead, they prefer to keep it alive as a talking point.
It's also telling that Ciscomani didn’t even show up at yesterday’s media event, despite his role in killing this crucial legislation (or maybe because of it). It seems he’d rather be seen at private fundraisers with Trump and Speaker Mike Johnson, far from voters' scrutiny.
Our border communities deserve better than political games. They deserve real solutions, and that's what I am committed to fighting for.

**Ian Cain: Massachusetts Gun Control Laws Go Too Far**
**Quincy, MA** \- Massachusetts lawmakers recently passed new gun control laws that go further than almost any gun laws in the country. The bill, pushed through by a progressive majority, imposes a sweeping array of restrictions on law-abiding gun owners, and are among the most stringent anti-gun owner laws in the country.
In the race for U.S. Senate, John Deaton has said he supports this anti-gun owner law putting him at odds with the Republican Party and a conservative movement who has been stunned by the new legislation. Deaton’s anti-gun and anti-second amendment statements go as far as to say he supports this progressive bill.
Ian Cain released the following statement on the new law: **“I have been clear that I support common-sense laws that don’t impede on second amendment rights. This new legislation is too radical and represents a dangerous overreach on our constitutional rights.”**
Cain added: **“No real conservative would support this infringement on rights and criminalizing responsible gun owners. Deaton is wrong on this issue, and I hope voters understand he is not the right choice for Massachusetts Republicans.”**

**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

From Aug. 1 to Aug. 11, Rick Scott floated his campaign nearly $900,000.
Then, a new poll dropped showing that Scott is favored by only 35% of Florida voters — double digits below DeSantis, Trump, and Rubio.
That same day, he dumped another**$725,000** into his campaign coffers.
Faced with these glaring issues around his reelection campaign, it's plain to see: **Rick Scott is scared.**
I've said it before, and I'll say it again — we are in striking distance of flipping Florida's Senate seat blue. **_[But up against the nine-figure personal fortune he's wielding to keep his campaign afloat, I can't get the job done without you. If anything, friend, "scared" doesn't do it justice. **Rick Scott is downright TERRIFIED of our grassroots movement to flip Florida blue. And between:**
* Polls that have shown us statistically tied for months

* A dire lack of enthusiasm, even from the most dedicated GOP voters

* A DISTURBING track record in the Senate

* The anticipation of high blue voter turnout to save abortion rights in Florida

* And a MASSIVE surge of enthusiasm to end MAGA's grip on our country

**— he has very good reason to be.**
He's only been in power this long because of the massive fortune,_made off his company's criminal Medicare fraud,_ he uses to keep it. **It's the only way he knows how to win a general election; something he's never done with more than 1.15% of the vote — and that margin sinks with every race.**
And there's a direct link between that ill-gained fortune and his consistently slim victories: **No one can relate to him.**
His policy positions — from a strict nationwide ban on abortions, to a tax plan that would kill crucial benefits and raise taxes by an average of **$1,480** on the middle class when the cost of living is already too high — are simply out of touch.
But that's just the thing, friend. Most people simply can't compete with his multimillion-dollar campaign spending. _I know I sure can't._
**But I didn't enter this race because I knew I could buy my way to the Senate.** I'm running because, like me, Floridians are fed up with his flimsy leadership and desperate thirst for power. We've had enough — and, friend _that's_ why he's spending millions of dollars to beat me.

clean_body: I am breaking down one of the most critical races in 2024. Find out why this Senate race is a MUST WIN. | Fellow Conservative, 30 years ago, I helped usher in a Republican takeover of the House of Representatives. Today, I am asking you to help us bring about the same change in the United States Senate. One place that we can pick up a seat is via Eric Hovde in Wisconsin. Republicans have the BEST map they’ve had in a decade in the Senate. There are 7 opportunities for us to FLIP Democrat held seats. In a moment I am going to ask you to join me in sending your personal endorsement to Eric Hovde but let me tell you why Eric Hovde and Wisconsin should be on your radar in the final months of this cycle. Eric Hovde is a born entrepreneur. Unlike his far-Left opponent, Tammy Baldwin, who has spent over three decades in Washington, he’s built a business. But that’s not all – Eric has also dedicated his time to help troubled community banks. He’s helped vulnerable children by providing shelter and care in Wisconsin and around the world. He represents the type of compassion that Callista and I have worked hard to promote through faith and hard work. I know he’d make an amazing United States Senator – but right now, he’s been outraised and outspent by Senate Democrats and liberal dark money Super PACs determined to send Tammy Baldwin back for a third term. So here’s my ask, Fellow Conservative. Will you support someone who wants to RESTORE THE AMERICAN DREAM, or let one of Kamala’s closest and most reliable supporters return to the Senate? | Eric is putting the same tenacity to running for Senate as he has when he was building his businesses, but he cannot do this alone. If he has any chance overcoming the millions flooding into one of the most important states for the road to the White House, he’ll need the support of every conservative like you – I hope you are. Thank you, Newt Gingrich | Join the Conversation: | Paid for by Hovde for Wisconsin

body:
You won’t believe it.
#
You won’t believe what happened.
**I was filming campaign content on the convention floor last night when two people approached me and shared that while I was filming my ask of YOU, they donated to my campaign!**
[****](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240823-1?refcode=em20240823-1-1061&amount=5&refcode2=1061_21716_C1DPx8&akid=1061%2E21716%2EC1DPx8)
It was so exciting to discuss with fellow Democrats why I’m running for Congress and how we can work together to deliver historic progress for working people — from paid leave to reproductive freedom to affordable health care and housing.
The Democratic National Convention just ended, and our party is energized and united. Now it’s time to get to work and build on this momentum to move our country forward and elect leaders who will push for bold change.
[**Can I count on you to join these two brand new supporters and pitch in $5 to help me win this race for Delaware’s open seat in the U.S. House and become the first out trans member of Congress?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240823-1?refcode=em20240823-1-1061&amount=5&refcode2=1061_21716_C1DPx8&akid=1061%2E21716%2EC1DPx8)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240823-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240823-1-1061&refcode2=1061_21716_C1DPx8&akid=1061%2E21716%2EC1DPx8)**

Sarah McBride

I was filming campaign content on the convention floor last night when two people approached me and shared that while I was filming my ask of YOU, they donated to my campaign! It was so exciting to discuss with fellow Democrats why I’m running for Congress and how we can work together to deliver historic progress for working people — from paid leave to reproductive freedom to affordable health care and housing. The Democratic National Convention just ended, and our party is energized and united. Now it’s time to get to work and build on this momentum to move our country forward and elect leaders who will push for bold change. Thank you! Sarah McBride

| | _**Why We Vote!**_
---
| | Friends, After four nights of the DNC and a speech from Kamala Harris to top it off, I have never been more convinced that this election will be one of the most consequential for our federal government. The Democrat Party has caved to the left wing of their party and they want to extend the dysfunction of the Biden-Harris administration through four years of an even more radical Harris-Walz ticket. The choice has truly never been more clear, we must vote for Republicans up and down the ballot in November. Not only do we need to vote, but we need to urge others to vote as well. This is why we will continue to work hard door knocking, phone banking, and reaching every potential voter to make sure all Hoosiers understand the importance of voting this November. Remember, we have one of our Super Saturdays tomorrow in a number of locations across the state. Please use the list below to find a location near you and come out to help us get out the vote! This is one of the best ways that volunteers can help protect Indiana from the vision for America presented at the DNC this week. Only with the help of all of you can we make sure that we reach our goals and secure victories this November. Thank you all for what you do!
---

| | Chairman Randy Head

_**🚨 DNC Recap 🚫**_
---
The DNC has been one big dog and pony show, attempting to trick Americans into thinking there is national support for the Harris-Walz ticket. We have trouble believing that one of the least liked VPs in recent history, coupled with a president who has the lowest approval ratings in modern history, is able to somehow rally national support for her campaign without the mandate of a primary election. Harris stole this ticket from Biden, and she is riding the sinking ship to the end in November. Many of you may not have watched the DNC, and we do not blame you. In case you missed it, here is a quick summary of the week... Spoiler, they couldn't stop talking about President Trump.
---
* Day 1
* The DNC kicked off in Chicago, where much like the DNC in 1968, the party is divided, removing the top of their ticket, and surrounded by angry liberal protesters.
* Most people spent the night attempting to get in the arena due to poor logistics and planning by the DNC, coupled with dangerous anti-Israel protesters surrounding them.
* To add insult to injury, not only did the Democrats push Biden off the ticket, they also pushed him out of a prime time speaking role, instead giving more attention to their own self proclaimed democratic-socialist Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
* Biden addressed America, only to rant about Donald Trump and attempt to use fear to encourage his party. He said he would be a unifier, but he has proven to be a divisive president.
* Did they talk about policy and what we need to correct as a country? No, at the end of it all Trump was mentioned over 147 times, while inflation was only mentioned twice.
* Day 2
* The DNC had a "ceremonial roll call" as the Democrats had already pledged all their delegates in a late night call back in July, ignoring the votes of millions of Democrats in primaries across the country, including 178,253 Hoosier Democrats.
* Barack Obama was the prime speaker, and he tried to compare Kamala to himself. However, Harris has a track record of far more liberal policies and the Democrats have caved even further to the left wing of their party since Obama left office.
* Once again, the Democrats blamed Trump for their own poor results, but the track record speaks for itself. Biden and Harris **o****pened the border, increased inflation, and let crime run rampant!******
* Again at the end of the night Trump had been mentioned 55 times. The border was mentioned only 5 times!
* Day 3
* Once VP candidate Tim Walz finally took the stage at 11:40 pm, he avoided any talk of policy or results. Focusing instead on attacking Trump and Vance calling them "weird" for wanting to help Americans on real issues.
* Walz said "We are not going back." Back to what? Low inflation? A secure border? Stability and strength abroad? Harris and Walz want to continue the last three and a half years of global instability, weak leadership, and economic turmoil.
* Day 4

* In a speech that did not address what the Harris-Walz administration would prioritize, Kamala Harris accepted a nomination that she did not earn and was not voted on by the American people.
* Rather than focus on policy and correcting the problems brought on by the Biden-Harris administration, Kamala instead, once again, focused on Donald Trump.

---
The DNC has been one big attempt to trick Americans into thinking there is broad support for a ticket that most Democrats didn't even vote for. They didn't spend the week casting a vision for America or their policies to improve our future and fix the problems we have had to face the last three years. Instead, the DNC was focused on one person... Donald Trump.

Here's to leading Indiana through strength of principle, conviction and heart! Harris stole this ticket from Biden, and she is riding the sinking ship to the end in November. Many of you may not have watched the DNC, and we do not blame you. In case you missed it, here is a quick summary of the week... Spoiler, they couldn't stop talking about President Trump. Day 1 The DNC kicked off in Chicago, where much like the DNC in 1968, the party is divided, removing the top of their ticket, and surrounded by angry liberal protesters. Most people spent the night attempting to get in the arena due to poor logistics and planning by the DNC, coupled with dangerous anti-Israel protesters surrounding them. To add insult to injury, not only did the Democrats push Biden off the ticket, they also pushed him out of a prime time speaking role, instead giving more attention to their own self proclaimed democratic-socialist Congresswoman Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez. Biden addressed America, only to rant about Donald Trump and attempt to use fear to encourage his party. He said he would be a unifier, but he has proven to be a divisive president. Did they talk about policy and what we need to correct as a country? No, at the end of it all Trump was mentioned over 147 times, while inflation was only mentioned twice. Day 2 The DNC had a "ceremonial roll call" as the Democrats had already pledged all their delegates in a late night call back in July, ignoring the votes of millions of Democrats in primaries across the country, including 178,253 Hoosier Democrats. Barack Obama was the prime speaker, and he tried to compare Kamala to himself. However, Harris has a track record of far more liberal policies and the Democrats have caved even further to the left wing of their party since Obama left office. Once again, the Democrats blamed Trump for their own poor results, but the track record speaks for itself. Biden and Harris o**pened the border, increased inflation, and let crime run rampant!** Again at the end of the night Trump had been mentioned 55 times. The border was mentioned only 5 times! Day 3 Once VP candidate Tim Walz finally took the stage at 11:40 pm, he avoided any talk of policy or results. Focusing instead on attacking Trump and Vance calling them "weird" for wanting to help Americans on real issues. Walz said "We are not going back." Back to what? Low inflation? A secure border? Stability and strength abroad? Harris and Walz want to continue the last three and a half years of global instability, weak leadership, and economic turmoil. Day 4 In a speech that did not address what the Harris-Walz administration would prioritize, Kamala Harris accepted a nomination that she did not earn and was not voted on by the American people. Rather than focus on policy and correcting the problems brought on by the Biden-Harris administration, Kamala instead, once again, focused on Donald Trump. The DNC has been one big attempt to trick Americans into thinking there is broad support for a ticket that most Democrats didn't even vote for. They didn't spend the week casting a vision for America or their policies to improve our future and fix the problems we have had to face the last three years. | Peter,

The truth about running a campaign is that they are a lot like job interviews where you – _the voters_ – are the hiring manager.

In the Granite State, you learn how to grill a candidate before you learn how to grill a hot dog. I’ve enjoyed every day on the campaign trail, getting to travel across the district and meet with voters to talk about the future we want to build together for our great state and country.

Whether it’s town halls, coffee shops, front porches, or backyards, one thing is clear: _Granite Staters are concerned about the relentless attacks on our fundamental freedoms, skyrocketing prices, and the future of our democracy!_

1. **Defend our freedoms.** Extreme judges and politicians across the country are going after reproductive freedom, and I will fight like hell to defend access to the full range of reproductive healthcare, including abortion, contraceptives, and IVF.
2. **Secure a fair deal for ALL.** I believe deep in my bones that no corporation is above the law, and I will stand up to corporate monopolies that are jacking up healthcare, prescription drugs, housing, and grocery costs to help support hard-working families.

**I 'm Mayra Flores, the America First Hispanic woman running in the biggest race in the nation.**

After we made history and flipped a blue seat red for the first time in 100 years, the Democrats threw the kitchen sink at me, **and I had to concede my race. **

My stomach is in knots - **the Democrats have already raised an astonishing $30 MILLION, and Kamala just raised $80 million bucks**(I know, I can't believe anyone would give her money either...but they do).

body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter,

The 2024 Democratic National Convention concluded in Chicago yesterday
with the Democratic Party refusing to invite a single Palestinian American
to speak on the main stage despite the Uncommitted Movement's courageous
efforts. This is a moral failure, and the Party must do better.

Justice Democrats Rashida Tlaib, Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, Cori Bush, Jamaal
Bowman, AOC, Ayanna Pressley, and Delia Ramirez called on Party leadership
to emulate its values and give Palestinians a voice at this historic
moment, standing in solidarity with Uncommitted delegates and the hundreds
of thousands of voters they represent.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240823.wcAHSa&refcode=em20240823-35932&t=1002&akid=35932%2E1203867%2EqW2lgz ]“The folks who are voicing their concerns about Gaza, they’re voicing
their grief, their fear. They want to know the party is going to hear
them, to see them, and say that this big tent includes you too.” — Summer
Lee on Uncommitted Movement delegates’ treatment at DNC.

Our members have led on calling for a ceasefire from the start, and now an
arms embargo with Israel. These policies are not only popular — polls
indicate they’re crucial to helping Democrats defeat Donald Trump in key
swing states this November.

There is no excuse or justification for the lack of Palestinian
representation at this week’s convention, and we will not rest until the
Party listens to the majority of its voters and acts accordingly.

The convention may be over, but we continue to call for:

* The Democratic National Committee to reject endorsements and outside
spending from AIPAC;

* The Biden-Harris administration to stop sending bombs and weapons for
the Israeli military to carry out its genocide against innocent
Palestinians;

* The Harris-Walz campaign and the Democratic Party to firmly stand in
support of an immediate, permanent ceasefire in Gaza.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240823.wcAHSa&refcode=em20240823-35932&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35932%2E1203867%2EqW2lgz ]If you’re with us and our progressive leaders in Congress fighting to
save the soul of the Democratic Party, consider pitching in a grassroots
contribution of $5 or more today to fuel our work in the
days ahead.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240823.wcAHSa&refcode=em20240823-35932&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35932%2E1203867%2EqW2lgz ]Contribute $5

We are disappointed, but we will not be discouraged or distraught. Our
collective fight for peace and human rights for ALL people must go on.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

body:
Trump’s odds of victory just went up and the most significant independent presidential candidate of the last twenty years just joined his team. If that doesn’t make you pause, it should.
| | | August 23, 2024 | [Read Online](https://link.mail.beehiiv.com/ss/c/u001.QGfsgyVxW3tkl1otTx5UQZc6URuYqXN7KwYa8lWvep5hv1uWHFdZfUtI_t3-Tltg5GEt-kzwxfn3dwioOFT2YXTJ5h2YWryOqBkjSaaTCMdwK4oV36ANxz_OwtHN5iK_TEr-xrJIwX7FjjH5AyXc540j515Hd7eX_4U9Hovu1gdMeH8G493pX1l5EfPARQF_mQOmTfxYTHxKxqkv6KQEn-X3H0YYWQOjyRHZED6ghmYZCxJwEEWCz1LgtdOTCnEP/495/am5zkdJoRMCxlYJRMf0oBA/h0/h001.Qu05UBwOdYUrkgr4Nctoy-THhbRwUtKrfD3YLePYgrA)

---
RFK Jr. dropped out of the race today and endorsed Donald Trump.
This turn of events saddens me. As you probably know I’m someone who thinks that Donald Trump has the wrong character and makeup to be a good President. I know multiple people who worked for him and regard him as immoral and destructive, and these were people who saw him every day.
RFK started his campaign as a Democrat and seemed to have a similar outlook. He switched to an Independent when he didn’t see a path in the Democratic primaries in part because there were no debates.
RFK’s campaign raised about $50 million directly and another $50 million through outside groups. But running as an Independent meant having to get ballot access in state after state, which is costly, difficult and fraught with legal challenges. His polling peaked around 19% but more recently has been closer to 4 or 5%.
RFK’s vote share decreased when Joe Biden dropped out and was replaced by Kamala Harris. His remaining voters overlap more with Trump’s support. If RFK had remained in the race, it probably would have helped Kamala at the margins.
So, what does RFK’s endorsement mean? It depends on what his voters do. Some of them will follow him to Trump. Some of them won’t vote. Some of them will go to other third party candidates. A handful may even go to Kamala Harris.
I think that RFK’s endorsement is worth about .5% to 1% of the vote for Donald Trump in the all-important swing states, maybe even more if RFK joins Trump on the trail. Recent polling has RFK at 7% in Nevada, 6% in Wisconsin, 5% in Arizona and Michigan, 4% in Georgia and 3% in Pennsylvania. The margin between Kamala Harris and Donald Trump is well below those numbers in all of those states.
I’m the co-chair of a third party myself – the Forward Party - so I have a sense of what motivates voters who don’t like the two parties. Indeed, 50% of Americans now identify as Independents, though some of them lean one way or the other.
RFK’s voters tend to be people who feel unspoken for and left out by the current system. Many are low propensity voters who have given up on politics as usual. If RFK campaigns in the swing states, he could actually expand the electorate by a crucial margin – getting an extra 10,000 anti-institutional voters showing up in each swing state is a big deal.
Why is RFK endorsing Trump? I think much of it is that he has felt respected by Trump and his team, while the Democrats refused to even take a meeting and often sued him to keep him off ballots. Of course, it’s difficult to trash someone as an anti-vaxxer conspiracy theorist and then say now “We welcome him into the fold!”
For the record, I think this is a mistake. If you’re serious about reaching out to Americans with different viewpoints, RFK Jr. and his followers qualify. And his voters genuinely may comprise the difference-makers in a tight election. If you want to win, you should at least have the conversation.
I also think that RFK Jr. endorsing Donald Trump is the wrong decision. Okay, the Dems have been jerks to you. And there may be a plum role for you in the Trump administration, as they don’t particularly care about who runs various agencies. But if you thought Donald Trump was the answer, why run in the first place?
There are many who will dismiss this turn of events as marginal to the race. I disagree, as in a race this tight any significant factor could matter. RFK Jr. kindled a genuine political movement that is now backing Trump. Trump’s odds of victory just went up and the most significant independent presidential candidate of the last twenty years just joined his team. If that doesn’t make you pause, it should.

| This month, students and teachers throughout the Lehigh Valley will wrap up their summer breaks and head back to school.

While this is a very exciting time for everyone, it also brings with it new headlines, stories, and legislation about Republican extremists trying to ban books and school curriculum.

While Republicans fight over which books are allowed in school libraries, I know there are much bigger issues facing our education system – **our students and teachers are fearing for their lives in the wake of gun violence, our teachers are underpaid, and the average American can’t afford higher education.**

_I have been a proud member of the Education and Labor Committee since my first term in Congress, and**I promise to continue fighting to better our education system for all Americans, regardless of their zip code or background.**_

Hi Friend! I was in Chicago for the Democratic National Convention (DNC), and as a first-time candidate, I'm honored to have the opportunity to advocate for our state and have the support of so many other Democrats. **When I was at the Rural Caucus Meeting with Congressman Benny G. Thompson, it brought me back to the countless conversations that I've had with Utahns.**
There is so much that we all have in common, Friend. [**Before I continue, can you help us take on our dark-money funded opponent by chipping in what you can today? >>**](https://cg4ut.us/l/kinBHKbocMWa)
---
| [ ](https://cg4ut.us/l/GMvcrBiEn6Bb)
---
**Speaking at the Rural Caucus meeting showed that Utahns and so many others often agree on what issues matter.** Housing affordability, money in politics, extremism, protecting our environment, and affordable healthcare are all top-of-mind issues for so many people. Friend, to a "political outsider" like me, solving these issues that we all agree on is just common sense. **_But to a career politician like our opponent, addressing these issues would mean putting aside the interests of his corporate donors and working against his party's interests._** [**Friend, with the DNC coming to a close, we can't forget that we must remain united behind our common-sense message. With less than 3 months until election day, we need your help. Can you please chip in what you can to our campaign today and help us take on our careerist opponent?**](https://cg4ut.us/l/gBvp8iACKJNB)
---
[ CHIP IN >> ](https://cg4ut.us/l/c8jhP1EJPmOd)

Let's take on the challenge, Caroline Gleich 🏔️

|

clean_body: The energy was electric, and the joy was contagious. | | | Peter, we just wrapped up a legendary week at the Democratic National Convention in Chicago. The energy was electric , and the joy was contagious. We’re not speaking hyperbole when we say that we might have topped the infamous dance party at the Democratic National Convention in 1996. While we didn’t break out in the “Macarena,” we still had some pretty big moments. Here are some of our favorite highlights: Michelle Obama told us to “Do something!” Georgia blew the roof of the United Center during their roll call vote with a surprise performance from Lil Jon. And, we got Oprah! “Kamalaaa Haaaaarris!” Democratic National Conventions are not just about politics -- they’re also moments of celebration. They’re powerful demonstrations of the strength of our party, and we are thrilled that you are a part of our movement, Peter. body:
for cringe and cluelessness

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_kamala_response&n=1)
---
Peter, The DNC and Kamala Harris have set a new record for cringe and cluelessness with their “hope and joy” branding campaign as they preside over record hardship and raging genocide. As the tightly choreographed DNC comes to a close, the synthetic “hope and joy” marketing blitz feels Orwellian and obscene compared to the real tears and desperation of the people outside crying out for basic human rights and an end to the horrific US-backed genocide in Gaza. Delegates representing the Uncommitted movement tried to bring a bit of reality into the DNC bubble, but the Democrats refused to hear it, rejecting even the modest request to let a vetted Palestinian-American speaker give an approved speech. Outside the convention, protesters read the names of murdered Palestinian children, but passing DNC delegates covered their ears and hurried past - or even mocked and ridiculed those reading the names. From the stage, prominent Democrats pronounced that Harris is “working tirelessly for a ceasefire” - a claim that’s not only false, but an outrageous whitewashing of the fact that **the Biden-Harris administration is literally sending the weapons fueling genocide in Gaza.** Peter, the Democrats have shown again and again that they're not interested in listening to you. **We are listening, and we're doing everything we can to fight for you - and for the victims of US empire who don't get a vote.[Please consider pitching in to support this critical life-or-death fight:](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_kamala_response&n=2)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_kamala_response&n=3 "DONATE") [DONATE](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_kamala_response&n=3)
---
The lie about “working tirelessly for a ceasefire” is especially shameless, and it’s typical of the Democrats’ empty words. Kamala Harris may offer lip service to some nice-sounding policies, but where have those been for the last three and a half years? What happened to Biden-Harris promises like raising the minimum wage and creating a public option for healthcare? Nothing \- these empty pledges were tossed out as soon as the election was over. The brazen gaslighting continued with Michelle Obama declaring that Democrats “don’t cheat others to get ahead” and “don’t change the rules so we always win” - while they’re trying to sue us off the ballot in multiple states, hiring spies and infiltrators to sabotage us, and withholding public funding we qualified for months ago. The DNC refuses to let voters have a choice even within its own party, where party elites hand-picked Harris as Biden’s successor after managing to avoid any real primary process. **Kamala’s DNC acceptance speech was a predictable parade of centrist platitudes peppered with jingoistic claptrap designed to outflank the Republicans to the right.** When she bellowed that she would make the US military the “most lethal fighting force in the world”, the crowd responded with chants of “U.S.A! U.S.A!” And she continued the disgusting gaslighting on Gaza with vague platitudes and crocodile tears while she and Biden are supplying the very bombs that are burning and shredding Palestinian children alive. DNC elites picked Kamala the political chameleon because she will say or do whatever they want her to. And that means, as Biden promised his Wall Street backers in 2020, that **“nothing will fundamentally change.”** While the Democrats have been acting out their rebranding show, **I’ve been in the streets of Chicago meeting with and listening to the people shut out of the DNC** \- just as I did in Milwaukee during the RNC. We marched with the Poor People’s Army for healthcare and housing as human rights. We rallied with Workers Strike Back for a $25/hour minimum wage. And we joined daily marches and actions to stop the genocide in Gaza and cut off US support for Israel until it ends its brutal occupation and apartheid regime. **Unlike Kamala Harris and the Democrats, my running mate Butch Ware and I are listening to the people and fighting for the real change we need right now.** Just like this DNC, the Democratic Party is phony to its core because it works for the elite donor class, not the voters. The Democrats can spend their mountains of corporate money on slick rebranding campaigns to convince people that things will be different this time, but all they will ever do is less than the bare minimum, because that’s the most their donors will allow. On just about any issue - workers’ rights, healthcare, housing, racial justice, immigration, climate change, voting rights, gun safety, women’s rights, you name it - **Kamala Harris and the Democrats will do less than the bare minimum.** And they will continue the endless wars that are dragging us closer and closer to the brink of a world war that humanity may not survive. Again and again, **the Democratic Party has shown that its function in the two-party system is to serve the same corporate imperialist agenda as the Republicans, while taking up the space where we _should_ have a genuine people’s party.** Enough is enough. We can’t waste any more time hoping for change from the same politicians who’ve betrayed us again and again. Real hope will only come from real change, and it’s up to us to make it happen. Together we can lead the charge for real democracy, an end to endless war and genocide, an economy that works for working people, a livable future for our children, and an America and a world that works for all of us. **The time is now to come together and rise up.[Please consider contributing whatever you can today to power our urgent fight for people, planet, and peace over profit.](https://www.jillstein2024.com/ba?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=dnc_kamala_response&n=4)**

The end of this month will be our first deadline after our convention, and since Kamala Harris chose Tim Walz as her running mate.
---
Derek, We’re about to ask you to donate directly to the DNC now that the Democratic convention is over and before our FEC deadline ends. If you give us a moment of your time, we’ll explain why your support is so important right now. Here’s the situation: **Our FEC deadline is rapidly approaching.** This is the first fundraising report we’ll file after Kamala Harris chose Tim Walz as her running mate, and after the Democratic National Convention. _Everyone_ will be watching closely to see how Democrats’ fundraising compares with the Trump-Vance campaign's. The results could dominate the headlines for days and coming up short could be trouble. A Peruvian gang leader, responsible for 23 murders, was arrested in Vestal, NY.

This news comes shortly after a 15-year-old girl was raped by an illegal immigrant in the Capital Region, a 21-year-old was suffocated to death in Central New York, and a young woman was sexually assaulted and strangled by an illegal immigrant in the Catskills.

This month, I continued to fight to protect our seniors. As healthcare costs rise, it’s crucial that we ensure affordable and accessible healthcare for all, especially our elderly population.

I’m committed to defending the healthcare benefits our seniors have earned and depend on.

\- [Rep. Molinaro Calls For Federal Action To Reverse Gov. Hochul’s Cuts To Disability & Senior Support Services](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=3cee34d666&e=a39a20e5dd)

I'm thrilled to see CAPCO’s next cycle of funding for early childhood programs take off. Investing in early childhood education is essential for the future of our communities.

These programs lay the foundation for lifelong learning and success, and I’m proud to support initiatives that benefit our youngest learners. [\- CAPCO Begins Next Cycle of Funding for Early Childhood Program](https://molinarofordutchess.us5.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b7a5de207e774ea8a3851d76c&id=c9c4b72e51&e=a39a20e5dd)

name: Darren Soto
subject: Filled with hope for what's next
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Darren Soto for Congress
body:
image of ... [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP59/1/107632/images/Screen%20Shot%202023-09-18%20at%208.13.37%20PM.png]

Friend,

Greetings from our beautiful slice of Central Florida! As your neighbor and representative, I have been focused on making our community a better place to live, work, and raise a family.

This week, we’ve been busy at the Democratic National Convention. I'm filled with hope for what’s next, as we’ve nominated Kamala Harris to be the Democratic nominee for the next President of the United States.

Under the Biden-Harris Administration, our story has been one of delivering results:

Over $2 billion secured for I-4 expansion from around 528 all the way to U.S. 27, along with over $1.3 billion for the Poinciana Parkway Connector
Over $200 million secured for Orlando International Airport to build/expand Terminal C, build a pedestrian bridge, and upgrade runways
$1.8 million secured for "The Haven on Vine" in Kissimmee, creating over 100 affordable housing units
Over $500 million for microchip manufacturing at NeoCity, creating high-paying jobs
16 million jobs created nationally under the Biden-Harris Administration, hitting the lowest unemployment rate in 50 years

Friend, will you join us by contributing to our campaign today? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/soto?refcode=August24&amount=9] Your support helps us continue this important work for our community and country.

Our recently-passed FY24 appropriations bill funded nearly $14 million in Community Projects for our district, with over $30 million requested for next fiscal year. These investments support affordable housing, transportation, healthcare, and education—all crucial for maintaining our quality of life.

The job is not done, and we need your help. Join me in rallying behind the Harris-Walz ticket. Let’s commit to expanding affordable housing, improving our infrastructure, protecting reproductive rights, enhancing our education system, and more.

Together, we're making our district an even greater place to call HOME.

- Darren

The four-day event featured speakers such as Barack and Michelle Obama, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Pete Buttigieg, Shawn Fain, and of course, Kamala Harris and Tim Walz: The now official Democratic nominees for President and Vice President of the United States. The Roll Call was on Tuesday, during which time delegates ceremoniously announced their votes. When Indiana’s turn came, Gary native Michael Jackson's "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough" filled the United Center, celebrating the Hoosier State’s nomination for the Harris-Walz administration to lead our nation forward. clean_body: | Welcome to the Indiana Democratic Party's weekly newsletter, The Kernel of Truth. The State Party will provide the most important fact - a kernel of truth - from the week. ** Hoosier Delegates Attend the Democratic National Convention and Nominate Kamala Harris and Tim Walz This week, Chicago played host to the 2024 Democratic National Convention. The four-day event featured speakers such as Barack and Michelle Obama, Bill and Hillary Clinton, Pete Buttigieg, Shawn Fain, and of course, Kamala Harris and Tim Walz: The now official Democratic nominees for President and Vice President of the United States. The Roll Call was on Tuesday, during which time delegates ceremoniously announced their votes. When Indiana’s turn came, Gary native Michael Jackson's "Don't Stop 'Til You Get Enough" filled the United Center, celebrating the Hoosier State’s nomination for the Harris-Walz administration to lead our nation forward. Actor Sean Astin, who played Rudy in 'Rudy' and Bob in Stranger Things, helped us deliver our votes for Kamala Harris and Tim Walz! = Indiana Is Way Behind on Education Hoosiers have been failed by twenty years straight of one-party Republican administrations. They have disinvested in communities across the state and the largest driver for upward mobility for all: public education. The results are that Indiana ranks 46th overall in education, and most of your tax dollars on K-12 education go to largely unaccountable charter schools instead of your neighborhood schools. Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks. On August 19, U.S. Rep. Frank Mrvan (D-1) announced the Munster Police Department was to receive $215,000 to upgrade its technology and equipment, with the goal of improving the Department’s efficiency, allowing its members to take on more cases. “We can always count on Congressman Mrvan to deliver for Munster. Frank has a servant’s heart and has always been a friend and supporter to law enforcement throughout my entire career, and this funding demonstrates his commitment to first responders and public safety,” Munster Police Chief Stephen Scheckel stated in a press release. **** State Rep. Chuck Moseley is prepared to continue his work on behalf of all Hoosiers working, playing, and living in Indiana’s 10th District. He was first elected in 2008, and throughout his tenure in the General Assembly he has become known for focusing on veteran’s affairs, having authored numerous bills concerned with providing accessible and affordable health care for veterans with PTSD. Join Jennifer McCormick at an Upcoming Event Jennifer will be joining Indy LaborFest on Saturday, August 24 from 12-6 pm at Garfield Park’s MacAllister Amphitheater. Entry is free, and activities include food trucks, an instrument zoo, live music, and more. To stay up to date with all her events, view for more information. Get Involved! I’m honored to be the Democratic nominee for the U.S. Senate from Texas. I’m a fourth-generation Texan, and everything I’ve done in my life – from making it to the NFL, to law school, and finally to Congress – is thanks to opportunities that Texas has given me. In my Texas, we believe that WE is more powerful than ME.

But Ted Cruz doesn’t believe in the Texas that I know and love. He doesn’t believe you should help your neighbors when things get tough. He doesn’t believe that our seniors deserve the Social Security and Medicare they have earned. He doesn’t believe that women should be able to make their own health care decisions.

**All Ted Cruz cares about is himself – and Texas deserves much better than a me-guy who runs to Cancun when we’re in crisis.

My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.
Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.
But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families.
I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.
After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.
Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.
He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.
They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.
That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.
But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, Peter.
And today, I need your help.

President Biden’s speech was inspiring. He got the chance to remind Americans about his unmatched record, remind the country that we have the strongest economy in the world. As he spoke about passing the torch to Kamala Harris, you could feel the joy in the room.

Kamala Harris is someone who does her homework. She’s prepared. She asks the tough questions. And she does not suffer fools gladly. I couldn’t be more excited to support her on the campaign trail and hear more about her vision for the country.

We also got to hear from a slew of Democratic leaders who laid out our vision for our future – a vision centered around freedom. Freedom for a woman’s right to choose, freedom to actually have the kind of books you want to read available for our kids in school, freedom in this country that allows us to stand up against oppression.

Frankly, I could go on and on about how optimistic the DNC made me feel. **The point is, the contrast between what Donald Trump and Democrats have planned for America is crystal clear.**

I met Boeing whistleblower Ed Pierson at National Whistleblower Day a few weeks ago. He brought with him newly unveiled documents from an anonymous whistleblower inside the company showing the embattled airline had lied about its knowledge of fatal issues leading up to two major crashes in 2018 and 2019. I[ took photos of some of those documents](https://substack.com/redirect/d0f007fb-c070-413c-80ad-f569ed1e133b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and am now providing the full evidence as promised.
Pierson's release of these documents has already garnered some [high-level media attention](https://substack.com/redirect/c4795a05-1788-4e0a-8244-dcdfb652c177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but as the Department of Justice mulls an [ill-advised plea deal](https://substack.com/redirect/c80af4ff-705e-4f52-9f04-5fd252d0750e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in its case against Boeing, more attention is needed.
[Download all the Boeing documents here.](https://substack.com/redirect/3f3d1c19-1ea3-40da-9720-9b811fc6af25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

# **Boeing 737 MAX Whistleblower Releases Documents Of Electrical Faults On Ethiopian Airlines Plane Involved In Deadly Crash**
_By Aaron Spray, SimpleFlying.com_
A [new set of documents](https://substack.com/redirect/c93a2a4b-e660-4a6a-af38-1abd439ac49e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) released by the Foundation for Aviation Safety (an advocacy group formed by former [Boeing](https://substack.com/redirect/fb152102-0ea7-401c-b9a0-249ef91e23e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) employee-turned-whistleblower Ed Pierson) suggests that an electrical malfunction could have caused [the Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 crash](https://substack.com/redirect/7c9cece9-7bfb-4a2b-be60-520dfaae0205?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The documents released on Thursday [outlined](https://substack.com/redirect/c4795a05-1788-4e0a-8244-dcdfb652c177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a "_slew of electrical issues_ " that were discovered as Boeing assembled the Ethiopian Airlines jet that crashed in 2019.
The documents outline confusion and chaos at Boeing's [Renton factory](https://substack.com/redirect/7cb69489-7e8d-4c2f-8e15-8794fc2d18bd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where the two [737 MAX](https://substack.com/redirect/ff45ed58-a67a-4c88-bd98-41181ade578f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) aircraft were built and later crashed. The twin crashes occurred in 2018 and 2019 and claimed the lives of some 346 people. In May 2024, the [FAA stated there's a "long road" ahead to restore Boeing's safety culture](https://substack.com/redirect/7b916040-f521-4015-9155-8f9e5b569bb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
## **FAA found Boeing may have quality issues**
In a [2018 report](https://substack.com/redirect/5d44f81a-e1ff-4ba1-8699-653b53f61564?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the FAA found that Boeing's Everett facility employees were pushed to move too fast and produced defective pieces. The FAA report responded to "_at least two Boeing employees working at the Electrical Systems Responsibility Center (ESRC) in Everett, Washington submitted formal whistleblower complaints to the FAA_." The Everett facility was where workers prepared electrical parts for use on the 737 MAX aircraft.
The FAA found that Boeing management was forcing employees to work within time limits, which could lead to defective parts at the electrical center. The FAA stated, "_Boeing Quality management is forcing employee's to work within a time limits which could result in defective parts to leave ESRC Boeing. Management has created 1-minute pre-inspections check sheets and has threatened QA to buy work off that is not performed by the individuals_." The FAA's onsite investigation at the facility occurred the same week as the Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 airplane was being built at the 737 factory in Renton.
According to Ed Pierson's allegations, the same production issues still affect the company today (despite [Boeing's own internal safety reports suggesting it has made major improvements](https://substack.com/redirect/d828c14c-28e0-40bc-959b-94e174ab641b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)).
## **FAA & NTSB blamed bird strike and MCAS**
However, the FAA and the NTSB have blamed Boeing's then-new software, the Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System (MCAS) for the Ethiopian Airlines crash. The [Seattle Times states](https://substack.com/redirect/c4795a05-1788-4e0a-8244-dcdfb652c177?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), _" Boeing recently pleaded guilty to misleading safety regulators about MCAS and how much training pilots would need to fly safely_."
The NTSB concluded that a bird strike damaged a sensor, likely triggering the MCAS software (and therefore stating it wasn't a faulty-manufactured electrical part causing an electrical error). Ethiopian authorities, for their part, claimed the MCAS software was triggered by "[production quality defects](https://substack.com/redirect/4dff63ed-7b91-46b8-92fc-501306c83af5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)."
## **Pierson claims manufacturing defects are at fault**
Pierson suggests that the records and an earlier safety incident point to the possibility that the Ethiopian jet crash may have been initiated by an electrical problem. According to Pierson, the problem traces back to production issues with electrical wire bundles. Pierson goes so far as to allege that "_Boeing knew the manufacturing was an absolute disaster._ "
Boeing [has denied](https://substack.com/redirect/5e876bdf-6904-4f05-9352-de7a9041f936?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Pierson's allegations. The Boeing statement says, "_We are confident that the NTSB and other accident investigative authorities and regulators are adequately assessing all potential causes of these accidents over the course of their rigorous, extensive, and independent reviews_." Yet the FAA 2018 report would seem to point to the opposite and support Pierson in some capacity.
## **Ethiopian 737 MAX had an "uncommanded roll" months prior**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/077f9c1c-70a3-4866-8ef3-4fddf89406cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The released documents also note that communications between Boeing and Ethiopian Airlines show that the same 737 MAX aircraft that later crashed experienced an in-flight safety incident months before it crashed. Documents show Boeing told Ethiopian Airlines that the incident likely resulted from an electrical error.
The aircraft experienced an "uncommanded roll" - an incident where the plane rolls on its own, often startling the pilot and risking the pilot losing control. Boeing told Ethiopian Airlines it suspected it could be an electrical fault and instructed the airline to check the wiring.
## **Boeing employee-turned whistleblower**
According to a [website](https://substack.com/redirect/423f6fa4-e6f2-4d82-af0a-53dec9c65141?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) dedicated to Ed Pierson, "_Ed Pierson, a former senior manager at Boeing 's 737 Factory in Renton, Washington, raised concerns to his supervisors about the dangerously unstable production environment and risks to the safety of airplanes. The factory was plagued with overworked employees, chronic part shortages, quality issues, and unrelenting schedule pressure to deliver MAX airplanes. Ed recommended Boeing leadership shutdown production operations before both crashes, but sadly he was ignored._"
Pierson worked for Boeing for over 10 years as a senior manager responsible for production system support for 737 commercial airplanes and the military version of the 737--the P-8 Poseidon aircraft. While still working for Boeing, he complained of safety risks from the frantic production pace in the summer of 2018 (he left Boeing in 2018).
His complaints were voiced months before the first fatal 737 MAX crash but fell on deaf ears. Since then, he has repeatedly stated that manufacturing defects played a role in the crashes. He claims the MAX fleet remains unsafe.

The FAA found that Boeing management was forcing employees to work within time limits, which could lead to defective parts at the electrical center. The FAA stated, "Boeing Quality management is forcing employee's to work within a time limits which could result in defective parts to leave ESRC Boeing. Management has created 1-minute pre-inspections check sheets and has threatened QA to buy work off that is not performed by the individuals." The FAA's onsite investigation at the facility occurred the same week as the Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302 airplane was being built at the 737 factory in Renton. According to Ed Pierson's allegations, the same production issues still affect the company today (despite ). FAA & NTSB blamed bird strike and MCAS However, the FAA and the NTSB have blamed Boeing's then-new software, the Maneuvering Characteristics Augmentation System (MCAS) for the Ethiopian Airlines crash. The , " Boeing recently pleaded guilty to misleading safety regulators about MCAS and how much training pilots would need to fly safely." The NTSB concluded that a bird strike damaged a sensor, likely triggering the MCAS software (and therefore stating it wasn't a faulty-manufactured electrical part causing an electrical error). Ethiopian authorities, for their part, claimed the MCAS software was triggered by "." Pierson claims manufacturing defects are at fault Pierson suggests that the records and an earlier safety incident point to the possibility that the Ethiopian jet crash may have been initiated by an electrical problem. According to Pierson, the problem traces back to production issues with electrical wire bundles. Pierson goes so far as to allege that "Boeing knew the manufacturing was an absolute disaster. " Boeing Pierson's allegations. The Boeing statement says, "We are confident that the NTSB and other accident investigative authorities and regulators are adequately assessing all potential causes of these accidents over the course of their rigorous, extensive, and independent reviews." Yet the FAA 2018 report would seem to point to the opposite and support Pierson in some capacity. Ethiopian 737 MAX had an "uncommanded roll" months prior | | ---|---|--- The released documents also note that communications between Boeing and Ethiopian Airlines show that the same 737 MAX aircraft that later crashed experienced an in-flight safety incident months before it crashed. Documents show Boeing told Ethiopian Airlines that the incident likely resulted from an electrical error. The aircraft experienced an "uncommanded roll" - an incident where the plane rolls on its own, often startling the pilot and risking the pilot losing control. Boeing told Ethiopian Airlines it suspected it could be an electrical fault and instructed the airline to check the wiring. Boeing employee-turned whistleblower According to a dedicated to Ed Pierson, "Ed Pierson, a former senior manager at Boeing 's 737 Factory in Renton, Washington, raised concerns to his supervisors about the dangerously unstable production environment and risks to the safety of airplanes. The factory was plagued with overworked employees, chronic part shortages, quality issues, and unrelenting schedule pressure to deliver MAX airplanes. Ed recommended Boeing leadership shutdown production operations before both crashes, but sadly he was ignored." Pierson worked for Boeing for over 10 years as a senior manager responsible for production system support for 737 commercial airplanes and the military version of the 737--the P-8 Poseidon aircraft. While still working for Boeing, he complained of safety risks from the frantic production pace in the summer of 2018 (he left Boeing in 2018). His complaints were voiced months before the first fatal 737 MAX crash but fell on deaf ears. Since then, he has repeatedly stated that manufacturing defects played a role in the crashes. He claims the MAX fleet remains unsafe. subject: “She should’ve let the man win.”
body:
https://www.tamiewilson.com/ [https://www.tamiewilson.com/]
Friends,
In her rousing speech at the DNC, Michelle Obama said it best:
“So no matter how good we feel tonight or tomorrow or the next day, this is going to be an uphill battle. We cannot be our own worst enemies. We cannot start wringing our hands. We cannot indulge our anxieties about whether this country will elect someone like Kamala instead of doing everything we can to get someone like Kamala elected."
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240823_michelle_obama_image1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240823_michelle_obama_image1]
Her words couldn’t be more true, especially for women in politics.
We’re often met with skepticism, dismissals, and outright condescension, and I’ve faced it myself.
Recently, a major supporter from Cleveland was inspired to help our campaign by hosting a fundraiser, but when he reached out to the local Democratic county party’s office, the person who answered the phone had the NERVE to say, “Why would you want to do that? She’s just going to lose. ”
Then, an Ohio State legislator told a group of people, “ She should have let the man win , someone who actually could’ve won that district.”
Stop and think about that last one for a second. If he was so certain that any man can win this district, but a woman can’t, then why would I have had to LET a man win the primary?
Let me be perfectly clear: Enough of this pessimistic, sexist bullsh**.
We're out here proving the doubters wrong every single day. We’re the best structured and financed campaign that Jim Jordan has ever faced, and we’re putting in the hard work every day. Make no mistake, we are going to make history. If you're with us, contribute today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240823_michelle_obama_link1]
We don’t have time for naysayers. We need action.
Michelle Obama isn’t just asking you to help—she’s telling us to get out there and DO SOMETHING.
We need every single person to step up, to say, “I did everything I could to defeat Jim Jordan.”
We can’t afford to sit back and wonder if a woman can win; we need to mobilize to make it happen.
This election, we will outwork Jim Jordan because we are fighting for policies that truly matter—like protecting reproductive rights, ensuring affordable healthcare for all, and advocating for working families.
We will prove that women can win, that we will win, and that we will fight for what’s right for our country.
So, let’s get out there and make history. Let’s dominate every effort to suppress us, move our country forward, and ensure that when November comes, we have done everything in our power to win.
I need you with me. Contribute today, and let’s show the doubters and the naysayers what we’re made of. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tamie-wilson-for-us-c2g?refcode=20240823_michelle_obama_link2]
Working for US,
Tamie Wilson

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

I’m writing to you today to shine a spotlight on the Ohio Supreme Court elections – **races that are absolutely vital to protecting our democracy.**

Our actions in the next three months will determine the next three decades in Ohio. Right now, the partisan state Supreme Court is blocking the policy choices of Ohioans, silencing the will of voters by permitting partisan gerrymandering.

[_**We need to re-elect Justice Michael Donnelly and Justice Melody Stewart and elect Judge Lisa Forbes to serve as fair minded justices who will not be swayed by anti-democratic agendas. Will you split a $5 contribution or even more to their campaigns today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91401514/493727824/453426980?amount=5&refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_JUDDemDef_240823_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWM4YThlZi05MjYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6WTW5iRuXVtu0Yb78nSCtzvy4aQhjTHuPlfnh9RnVw=)

Justice Michael Donnelly, Justice Melody Stewart, and Judge Lisa Forbes will protect our constitutional rights and maintain integrity and independence in our judicial system. That’s why the **National Democratic Redistricting Committee named them 2024 Democracy Defenders.**

They are the last line of defense for our rights and freedoms. Here’s a secure link where you can contribute to support their campaigns: [_**https://secure.actblue.com/donate**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91401515/493727826/453426980?refcode=ODP_ATA_EM_FR_JUDDemDef_240823_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84OTI0NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI3YWM4YThlZi05MjYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=e6WTW5iRuXVtu0Yb78nSCtzvy4aQhjTHuPlfnh9RnVw=)

Failure is not an option, team. We must work to ensure that Ohio has a Supreme Court that will enhance our democracy and protect the rights of the people.

Thank you for standing with me,

Eric H. Holder, Jr.
82nd Attorney General of the United States
Chairman of the National Democratic Redistricting Committee

During my speech tonight, I had the honor of sharing a little bit about my
family.

My mother was a teenager when I was born and she struggled with addiction.
I never met my father.

But I had two incredible grandparents who stepped in and raised me.
Everything I know, I learned from them.

In every way a child needs, my grandparents were there for me. As they
grew older, it was my privilege to be there for them.

So, when I work to protect Medicare and Social Security, I do it with the
personal knowledge of what those big programs meant in small but deeply
meaningful ways to my grandparents.

I know what they mean for your parents and grandparents.

But let’s be clear: That is all at risk today.

Right-wing extremists like Donald Trump and my opponent, Eric Hovde, want
to bring us back in time. If they had it their way, they’d cut Social
Security and Medicare. Overturn the Affordable Care Act. Further restrict
our reproductive rights. Give tax breaks to billionaires and big
corporations while our working families foot the bill.

We can’t let that happen, and as long as we stand together, I know we
won’t.

This November, we have the opportunity to move our country forward — to
protect and expand affordable health care, restore reproductive rights,
cut costs for working families, and protect Social Security and Medicare
for our parents and grandparents. But it will take ALL of us.

body:
Team, I spoke to the Democratic National Convention about my service in the Marines, how that made me who I am today, and why I am running for U.S. Senate.
[_**And now, I am asking you to make a split donation to Upset the Setup and my campaign — to defeat Trump and Kari Lake in Arizona and defend all the progress we have made together. Please, if you can afford it, chip in by using this link.**_](https://click.everyaction.com/k/91403431/493734623/-823092696?amount=3&refcode=UTS_FR_90DO_240823_1_1_GallegoDNC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAwNy8xLzg5NDc2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjY0NzRlZGVjLTk4NjEtZWYxMS05OTFhLTYwNDViZGRiZmM0YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=sN78QFYfIUrNucjVLu8Tpo5ICSWWXhlomtoYosgF24w=)
My unit was the hardest-hit Marine battalion of the entire war. But the fight didn’t end there.
Instead, my brothers and I found that we had a whole other fight ahead of us: The fight to get the care we were promised. The care we earned.
But I never lost hope. I took on the work myself. I figured out how I could get my guys recognition, their services, their disability payments. I went to Congress to change the system, to make sure it lived up to the promises we make to the people who serve, and to their families.
I slept by a burn pit while I was in Iraq, and countless others did the same. Guys I deployed with, healthy, strong guys, came down with serious illnesses because of those burn pits.
After a long, tough fight, we passed the PACT Act to provide benefits for veterans with those toxic exposures. And now, more than a million veterans from multiple generations are finally getting the help they need.
Trump had four years to get that bill done, and he didn’t. He dodged the draft himself and made some other guy take his place. He called fallen Marines from World War I buried in France “suckers” and “losers.” Just last week, he insulted the few who earned our nation's most sacred military honor, the Medal of Honor.
He and Kari Lake want you to believe our military and our veterans have no greater champion. But they don’t care about us. Theirs is the same record that landed my guys back home needing to scrape and claw for PTSD treatment, for health care, for basic dignity.
They have no place leading this nation, and after all the progress we have made together over the last few years, it is on us to do everything we can to defeat them.
That’s what I told the audience at the Democratic National Convention, and that is why I am running for U.S. Senate in Arizona.
But I can’t do it alone. In everything I’ve accomplished in life, I’ve always had a team behind me. You are a critical part of that team, friend.
And today, I need your help.

#
I think that Kamala Harris becoming the Democratic nominee for President is a rediscovery of what hope feels like, in a much deeper way.
It’s the difference between bailing out a boat, and sailing a boat. When you’re so consumed with, “How do we keep this thing up?” — it’s stressful, and important.
But now — we can look up and say, **“Where do we want to take this thing?”**
And to me, the long term of where we want to take this is people’s joy, dreams, and the fight for guaranteed healthcare, for a living wage, and for union jobs.
We just concluded the Democratic National Convention, and there are 74 days until the election.

| My fellow Marylanders, As the new school year begins, I want to extend my best wishes to all students, teachers, and families. The Moore-Miller Administration’s commitment to students’ educational success is unbreakable, and we're working to ensure every child has the tools they need to succeed. That's why we are**fully committed to implementing the Blueprint for Maryland’s Future**. It’s why I signed and authored the **Educator Shortage Reduction Act** to address educator shortages across the state and help current and future educators succeed. And just a week ago, I announced **[new investments to enhance energy efficiency and reduce operating expenses for public schools](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..thm3nTrFs3wTEI2-gPC65ViEH-Pmwgd6wzg8t79aXHE/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)** across the state, including in Anne Arundel, Frederick, Garrett, Baltimore City, Dorchester, Wicomico, and Prince George's Counties. We are on the right path to building an education system that leaves no one behind. Lt. Governor Miller and I believe it’s critical that every student knows their state loves them and that we’re creating policies and plans to help them thrive, both in and outside of the classroom. So, students: Stay curious, stay focused, and let’s make it a great year!

|
