## [Attending the 2024 Maryland Association of Counties Summer Conference in Ocean City](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDMsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZ292ZXJub3IubWFyeWxhbmQuZ292L25ld3MvcHJlc3MvUGFnZXMvZ292ZXJub3ItbW9vcmUtYXR0ZW5kcy0yMDI0LW1hcnlsYW5kLWFzc29jaWF0aW9uLW9mLWNvdW50aWVzLXN1bW1lci1jb25mZXJlbmNlLmFzcHgiLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODIzLjk5NDY4NTExIn0.gRzZRtkpR2nVD7kiV_XFCzwhnT720gIjZuAbYmOKY9w/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)

[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDQsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnlvdXR1YmUuY29tL3dhdGNoP3Y9cjRmWUJiUEhRZEkiLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODIzLjk5NDY4NTExIn0.08Ttg1tOQYekPnglxv2s0KwCSZNcL6tnxA7FIV6AOU8/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)Days ago, I visited the Eastern Shore for this year’s Summer MACo Conference with Lt. Governor Miller and our cabinet. While there, we met with local elected leaders and MACo leadership and attended numerous events. In my keynote address, I spoke about the progress our Administration has made, the challenging work ahead, the importance of strengthening Maryland’s economy, and the critical value of partnerships to help us emerge stronger as a state. Our Administration is data-driven and heart-led. That’s why we’ve been able to work together to invest in programs that move Maryland forward – and ones that matter most to Marylanders. The road ahead will be tough, but I know we have what it takes to secure Maryland’s future and win the decade.
## [Joining President Biden and Vice President Harris for Major Announcement on Lower Medicare Drug Pricing](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDUsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmluc3RhZ3JhbS5jb20vcC9DLXZsamFOUjlTdy8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODIzLjk5NDY4NTExIn0.AbL7u3QzgDuNAWOOhSvXaLUJFjB4rfVncu_1XxUsxyc/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)

[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDYsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3LnlvdXR1YmUuY29tL2xpdmUvUlI5SzU1VHZnOTA_c2k9WFNva0tlMHdyNzAwT0R3TCIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDA4MjMuOTk0Njg1MTEifQ.A9dL2f_RrNMt4lX52IuQYQ4fk8QmjZWKDfW4V07uhbc/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)Last week, I joined President Biden and Vice President Harris as they announced new efforts to make prescription drugs more affordable through the Inflation Reduction Act. Maryland is a proud partner in this Administration's efforts to protect, defend, and strengthen Americans' basic rights. From working to lower drug costs through our first-in-the nation Prescription Drug Affordability Board and protecting investments in Medicaid, to putting a referendum on the ballot to codify reproductive freedom into our Constitution, Maryland is ready to lead.
## **[Celebrating National Night Out with Residents in Howard County](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDcsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmluc3RhZ3JhbS5jb20vcmVlbC9DLVl5VEthdDNUYi8_IiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDgyMy45OTQ2ODUxMSJ9.oT_fF_V6GSZGYZwY1t2YDy6mKXnGXkkQT9xs1syJgo0/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)

**
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDgsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vd3d3Lmluc3RhZ3JhbS5jb20vcmVlbC9DLVl5VEthdDNUYi8iLCJidWxsZXRpbl9pZCI6IjIwMjQwODIzLjk5NDY4NTExIn0.ygHQ9siJIulwZe-4YiThIRsNWopo0N9kPaFsem5pf9g/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)Public safety is my number one priority as Governor – and everyone plays a role in protecting our communities, from parents and village elders to community leaders and our law enforcement officers. That’s why, on Day One, our Administration took an all-of-the-above approach to public safety. Together, we have:
* Worked to improve coordination between our State’s Attorneys, public defenders, elected leaders, and local law enforcement agencies,

* Required accountability both for those who commit crimes – and those sworn to protect us, and

* Built paths to opportunity so young people don’t feel they have to resort to crime as a way to survive.

Homicides and non-fatal shootings in Maryland are trending toward the lowest levels we’ve seen in a decade, but I know there’s still more work to do. By working together, there’s no obstacle that can stand in our way.
## **[Our Administration's Latest Investments to Make Maryland More Competitive](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDksInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZ292ZXJub3IubWFyeWxhbmQuZ292L25ld3MvcHJlc3MvUGFnZXMvZGVmYXVsdC5hc3B4IiwiYnVsbGV0aW5faWQiOiIyMDI0MDgyMy45OTQ2ODUxMSJ9.i2SZZGm_OVuLJb2eaf0TJahJaQmQMBDHjXchk7jV_H8/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)

**
[](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..QyGETdfc-Yh3WdgNmh0txR1lJjuSJi50sG3L1jDgJgE/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)Our Administration is committed to making smart investments that help make Maryland more economically competitive. Here are some of the recent investments we’ve made:
* We announced**$4.7 million** in federal funding to provide training and job placement to [grow Maryland’s offshore wind workforce](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..nXJVlmTF-b2rkd_hKPcJGaDzlBmqgNPYJ1iPfSXzx_c/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l).

* We launched the [Higher Education Clean Energy Grant Pilot Program](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..ErPLrLJ-h7fJUVIcyTCcXCGVmijDEISO4G6kTkYuPi8/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)**,** a **$9.2 million** initiative to support clean energy transitions in Maryland's colleges and universities.

* We provided **$7.3 million** in workforce grants to [help Maryland workers ](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..-Pq6UtPyfUy9hAB1xWTOb_Ww99MQN8Tywba67uSMwUQ/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l)gain new skills in healthcare, IT, skilled trades, and hospitality industries through the EARN Maryland program.

* We allocated**$11 million** to support advanced manufacturing and innovation projects during [our visit to ION Storage Systems](https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cCI6IkpXVCJ9..c7AWYkuR0LioAtbeHrnNSwTbKHD5H6jTZ0KIRhffh1M/s/3129413633/br/247940433635-l) in Prince George's County.

And just a week ago, I announced across the state, including in Anne Arundel, Frederick, Garrett, Baltimore City, Dorchester, Wicomico, and Prince George's Counties. We are on the right path to building an education system that leaves no one behind. Lt. Governor Miller and I believe it’s critical that every student knows their state loves them and that we’re creating policies and plans to help them thrive, both in and outside of the classroom. So, students: Stay curious, stay focused, and let’s make it a great year! | | ago, I visited the Eastern Shore for this year’s Summer MACo Conference with Lt. Governor Miller and our cabinet. While there, we met with local elected leaders and MACo leadership and attended numerous events. In my keynote address, I spoke about the progress our Administration has made, the challenging work ahead, the importance of strengthening Maryland’s economy, and the critical value of partnerships to help us emerge stronger as a state. Our Administration is data-driven and heart-led. That’s why we’ve been able to work together to invest in programs that move Maryland forward – and ones that matter most to Marylanders. The road ahead will be tough, but I know we have what it takes to secure Maryland’s future and win the decade. week, I joined President Biden and Vice President Harris as they announced new efforts to make prescription drugs more affordable through the Inflation Reduction Act. Maryland is a proud partner in this Administration's efforts to protect, defend, and strengthen Americans' basic rights. From working to lower drug costs through our first-in-the nation Prescription Drug Affordability Board and protecting investments in Medicaid, to putting a referendum on the ballot to codify reproductive freedom into our Constitution, Maryland is ready to lead. safety is my number one priority as Governor – and everyone plays a role in protecting our communities, from parents and village elders to community leaders and our law enforcement officers. That’s why, on Day One, our Administration took an all-of-the-above approach to public safety. Together, we have: Worked to improve coordination between our State’s Attorneys, public defenders, elected leaders, and local law enforcement agencies, Required accountability both for those who commit crimes – and those sworn to protect us, and Built paths to opportunity so young people don’t feel they have to resort to crime as a way to survive. Homicides and non-fatal shootings in Maryland are trending toward the lowest levels we’ve seen in a decade, but I know there’s still more work to do. Derek —

Robert F. Kennedy, Jr. just announced at a Phoenix press conference that
he is dropping out of the presidential race and endorsing Donald Trump.

The facts speak for themselves:

RFK Jr. did not even qualify for the ballot in 26 states.

He selected a running mate with no political experience but a personal
fortune she was all too willing to spend. For both of them, it was never
more than an effort to call attention to themselves and their conspiracy
theories.

His popularity has all but collapsed after numerous bizarre campaign
revelations, which I need not detail here. (But he did once file a
frivolous lawsuit against Facebook where he mentioned me for opposing
dangerous vaccine misinformation. He lost the lawsuit, and now, RFK Jr. is
done in presidential politics.)

RFK Jr. has dropped any pretense whatsoever of running his campaign on his
own merits after his running mate openly wondered this week whether to
“join forces” with Trump’s campaign to stop Kamala Harris and Tim Walz.

“We draw votes from Trump,” she said.

Now, they are openly working with Trump to help him win this election.

30 years ago, I helped usher in a Republican takeover of the House of Representatives.

Today, I am asking you to help us bring about the same change in the United States Senate. One place that we can pick up a seat is via Eric Hovde in Wisconsin.

But that’s not all – Eric has also dedicated his time to help troubled community banks. He’s helped vulnerable children by providing shelter and care in Wisconsin and around the world.

He represents the type of compassion that Callista and I have worked hard to promote through faith and hard work. I know he’d make an amazing United States Senator – but right now, he’s been outraised and outspent by Senate Democrats and liberal dark money Super PACs determined to send Tammy Baldwin back for a third term.

Like so many of you, I grew up with parents who worked hard in pursuit of the promise of America.
We were taught to see a world beyond just ourselves. To be conscious and compassionate about the struggles of all people. We were raised to believe public service is a noble cause and the fight for justice is everyone’s responsibility.
**In fact, my mother used to say, "Don't sit around and complain about things -- do something.” She was saying,_you have to get up and fight_. _And that is exactly what we are going to do for these next 74 days._**
Our campaign is a fight for the future. And it is a fight for our freedom.
The freedom to vote;
The freedom to live safe from gun violence;
The freedom to love who you love openly and with pride;
And the freedom for a woman to make decisions about her own body.

First, I want to say thank you. Thank you for making me your Democratic nominee. Thank you for believing that the promise of America is possible for each and every one of us. Thank you for always standing with Tim and me. | If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | Like so many of you, I grew up with parents who worked hard in pursuit of the promise of America. We were taught to see a world beyond just ourselves. To be conscious and compassionate about the struggles of all people. We were raised to believe public service is a noble cause and the fight for justice is everyone’s responsibility. In fact, my mother used to say, "Don't sit around and complain about things -- do something.” She was saying,you have to get up and fight. And that is exactly what we are going to do for these next 74 days. Our campaign is a fight for the future. And it is a fight for our freedom. The freedom to vote; The freedom to live safe from gun violence; The freedom to love who you love openly and with pride; And the freedom for a woman to make decisions about her own body. | | Peter,

We had a blast this week at the DNC.

The Collective PAC and Democrats around the country are fired up and ready to make history by sending Kamala Harris back to the White House as the _**first Black female President of the United States!**_

We were honored to be joined by leaders like Sen. Laphonza Butler and Gov. Wes Moore at our Collective Power Brunch, as well as special guests like John Legend and Michael Ealy! [ ](https://an.collectivepac.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqtxV2SCukgR7U0FmW9XFjbAPlQfWrDy8tz0p0TRfY3kC2u2T49qe59FRDOR9dIaNE6lj4rPj33ttuvl4lAqMaJ6D1Ned11GlecZcVclQa6xt3Moc-z8ICtmJ1AelYB0ElP7Y5s9W487O7g3EtCQ--TXw9Mb-5kw8QtLBGAX8TH0oRRXlKBdFsON6N7SJeF7aGF3pMaIXHI2s-ppdZ8Z-PLfuYr6akZQc3NifnzFlm5VTI0cu3laiRwNgcPrJ67MUhPTmlpHA-1PhlKCU8NsPAaMAUSlIrLTVglv9Cg55CM940J2bhmCbOlKJ-SEM10miw8RxkzdRJ_SAhmCLsMHpPhqsQMUiGd3qiHsD6iPVysZkKyrlmQUPD61ASQtYh9U-Woxf4xUdNK8Y92AdpCWj7D5qSa0noIcku-mS_jV6I_hyw/495/YbdZmkS9S4W3VuoNRPdN9g/h1/h001.iLhwlrQHUMpHlWs1xo39rSuHwjG7mTCFfmOW1R3KPA4) On night one, President Biden took the stage to tout the historic progress his administration has made and pass the torch to Kamala Harris. Then on night two, the Obamas took the stage, with the former president reminding us of how much is possible when we come together to make change. We heard from Democratic leaders from across the country and watched as Gov. Tim Walz accepted the official vice presidential nomination.

Finally, we witnessed Vice President Kamala Harris make history _once again_ as she became the first Black woman to accept the presidential nomination.

Now it’s time to get to work. We have _**74 DAYS**_ to turn out more voters than ever before — rivaling turnout levels from the historic 2008 and 2012 elections.

I just spoke at the Democratic National Convention to share the stakes of this election.
Derek,
I just spoke at the Democratic National Convention to share the stakes of this election.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240823?refcode=em20240823-9311&refcode2=9311_434096_4XKEw1&akid=9311%2E434096%2E4XKEw1)
**[Keep PA blue »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240823?amount=5&refcode=em20240823-9311&refcode2=9311_434096_4XKEw1&akid=9311%2E434096%2E4XKEw1)**
**Here’s the simple truth: Pennsylvania is the battleground that will decide this election** – and with the Democratic ticket official, it’s time to hit the ground running.
Our fundamental rights are on the ballot this November. If we want to protect our basic freedoms like women’s rights, workers’ rights, and voting rights, we must keep our Commonwealth blue.
My opponent is a Wall Street multi-millionaire who’s only out for his bottom line, even if it hurts working families, and he’s made it clear that he would be a “yes” vote for Donald Trump’s extreme agenda. He doesn’t understand what Pennsylvanians are going through or what they need.
I believe you need to know people to represent them. I was born and raised in Scranton, Pennsylvania. I raised my family there, and I still live there today.
Here in Pennsylvania, we strive to be a Commonwealth in life as well as in name. I know the challenges we face, fight for our values, and will always stand up for working people over big corporations and special interests.
We cannot keep our Senate majority or the White House without winning in Pennsylvania, which is why your support is so critical.
**[With so much at stake, please split a donation between John Fetterman and me today. Your support will make a real difference this November.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20240823?refcode=em20240823-9311&refcode2=9311_434096_4XKEw1&akid=9311%2E434096%2E4XKEw1)**

With gratitude,
Bob Casey

My opponent is a Wall Street multi-millionaire who’s only out for his bottom line, even if it hurts working families, and he’s made it clear that he would be a “yes” vote for Donald Trump’s extreme agenda. He doesn’t understand what Pennsylvanians are going through or what they need. I believe you need to know people to represent them. I was born and raised in Scranton, Pennsylvania. I raised my family there, and I still live there today. Here in Pennsylvania, we strive to be a Commonwealth in life as well as in name. I know the challenges we face, fight for our values, and will always stand up for working people over big corporations and special interests. clean_body: [] Friends, Kamala Harris delivered a powerful speech last night that will resonate with all of us for years to come. I was particularly struck by this line: "I will be a President who unites us around our highest aspirations. A President who leads. And listens. Who is realistic. Practical. And has common sense. And always fights for the American people." Her words reinforced the importance of our mission on this campaign – to fight for every American’s rights and to ensure a brighter future for our country by flipping the House and defeating Jim Jordan. Just like Kamala spelled out, we are going to defend reproductive rights and our freedoms and deliver on lowering costs for working families—something ULTRA-MAGA has no interest in, as they’re too busy catering to their billionaire friends. If you believe in a future where our rights are protected and working families are prioritized, contribute today! [] I brought 25 amazing people to this convention, and together, we made a huge statement about how strong our campaign is. From holding street rallies with our 4-foot signs to strengthening relationships with the press and lawmakers, we were out there daily, showing the world that we’re ready to send Jim Jordan packing. [] While we had a lot of fun, we also got down to some serious business in Chicago. I had the privilege of speaking with leaders like Representative Jamie Raskin, Governor Gavin Newsom, Senators Bernie Sanders, Richard Blumenthal, and Mazie Hirono about my legislation, The Comp rehensive Sexual Abuse Prevention and Accountability Act . We’re already scheduling appointments with lawmakers to build even more support for this important bill that will ensure abusers and abuse enablers like Jim Jordan can’t hide from justice. In the hundreds of conversations that I had - with delegates, activists, House Members, Governors, and Senators – everyone was on board to defeat Jim Jordan. They all understand what we have been saying for months: he is the most dangerous man in Congress and a direct threat to the continuation of our democracy. And that’s why we are headed home with a renewed fire in our bellies to win. As Coach Walz said, we’re going to leave it all on the field. This week has shown that we have the momentum, passion, and support to win this race. But to do that, I need your help. Contribute today to help us finish the job and make history. Together, we can send Jim Jordan home for good and bring Ohio the leadership it deserves to Washington. [] Working for US, Tamie Wilson [] Donate to Tamie Today [] Tamie Wilson is the Democratic nominee ready to unseat ULTRA MAGA extremist Jim Jordan in OH-04. A single mom and survivor who knows what it’s like to endure and overcome challenges, Tamie's fighting for jobs, healthcare, and positive change for everyday Americans. Your donations will help Tamie turn out every voter we need to flip this seat and send Jordan packing. | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/91408248/493750991/1654258770?refcode=header-img&amount=25&&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNDdjNTM3My1hODYxLWVmMTEtOTkxYS02MDQ1YmRkYmZjNGIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dEsasd6Z-UHl9Qt7lYVJ1Nkd5FGJunhzpDpc7XJW8Fo=)

Peter, it’s Ritchie. My resume is simple:

_I don’t have a college degree, I grew up in vermin-infested public housing, and I was raised by a single mother in the Bronx._

But I _do_ know what it’s like to go to bed hungry. I _do_ know what it’s like to experience hate and discrimination as an LGBTQ+ Afro-Latino man. I _do_ have more in common with the average American than I do with my colleagues — _and I’m proud of it._

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years. Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant. Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans. Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. body:
Did you catch Elizabeth’s speech at the Democratic National Convention?

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2323%2E4032634%2EqnFYmo)
---
Did you catch Elizabeth’s speech at the Democratic National Convention last night? | [](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2602?t=8&akid=2323%2E4032634%2EqnFYmo)
---
[](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2602?t=9&akid=2323%2E4032634%2EqnFYmo)
---
_[**(If you haven’t had the chance to watch yet, you can here!)**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2602?t=10&akid=2323%2E4032634%2EqnFYmo)_
Elizabeth spoke about why Kamala Harris and Tim Walz are the candidates we can trust to look out for our families — and why Donald Trump and JD Vance aren't. (As Elizabeth put it: she wouldn't even trust them to move her couch.)
And the reception in the room is a testament to our progressive movement we’ve built together for big, structural change. Our fight for bold ideas like a two-cent wealth tax, student debt cancellation, taking on big corporations, and confronting corruption in Washington head-on.
From creating the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, to defeating a popular Republican incumbent and getting elected to the U.S. Senate from Massachusetts in 2012, to launching a campaign for president in 2019 built on ideas and progressive values, to helping elect Warren Democrats up and down the ballot and across the country, to now standing up against corporate megadonors who want to buy this Senate seat in 2024, our movement has taken on plenty of fights in plenty of forms.
And throughout them all, we’ve always fought to put power in the hands of working people. We’ve shown that we _can_ use the power of government to transform people’s lives. From canceling $168.5 billion in student debt so far to passing a minimum tax on massive corporations that were paying $0 in taxes, we’ve proven that bold ideas can be transformed into real policies and real change is possible — when we organize and when we fight.
As Elizabeth says: “Choose to fight only righteous fights, because then when things get tough — and they will — you will know that there is only one option ahead of you: nevertheless, you must persist.”
This is a powerful moment in our democracy — and last night showed how so many volunteers, grassroots donors, and Democratic supporters are fired up to get in this fight. It's time to keep channeling that energy.
**Let’s continue to fight our righteous fight together, elect Kamala Harris and Tim Walz, defend our Senate Majority, and keep up the fight to make our government work for working people.**
[**We couldn’t be more grateful to fight by your side. If you’re able, please pitch in $28 or anything you can to support Elizabeth’s re-election campaign and continue growing our movement.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2603?amount=28&t=11&akid=2323%2E4032634%2EqnFYmo)
